title: US army secretary resigns after months of tension
english: US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll has resigned following persistent disagreements with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Known for his focus on military drone technology and close ties to the Trump administration, Driscoll is the latest in a series of high-ranking officials to leave the Pentagon. His departure occurs amidst a broader trend of military leadership changes under the current administration.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የጦር ሠራዊት ዋና ጸሐፊ ዳን ድሪስኮል ከመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩ ፒት ሄግሴዝ ጋር ለወራት ሲካሄድ በቆየው አለመግባባት ምክንያት ስራቸውን ለቀዋል። በወታደራዊ ድሮን ቴክኖሎጂ ላይ ባላቸው ትኩረት እና ከፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ አስተዳደር ጋር ባላቸው የቅርብ ግንኙነት የሚታወቁት ድሪስኮል፣ በቅርቡ ከስልጣን ከለቀቁ ከፍተኛ የመከላከያ ባለስልጣናት መካከል አንዱ ሆነዋል። ይህ ድርጊት አሁን ባለው አስተዳደር ስር በወታደራዊ አመራሮች ላይ እየተደረገ ካለው ተደጋጋሚ ለውጥ ጋር ተያይዞ የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Hogganaan waraana Ameerikaa Dan Dristikool, ministira ittisaa Piit Heegseet waliin wal dhabdee turte hordofee hojii isaa gadhiiseera. Gadhiisuun inni hojii isaa gadhiise kun, jijjiirama hoggansa waraana kanneen amma mootummaan amma jiru keessatti mul'achaa jiru keessaa tokko dha.

title: 'I've never been to Afghanistan': Six million deportees forced to start over under the Taliban
english: Over six million Afghans have been forced to return to their home country from Pakistan and Iran due to strict crackdowns on migrants. Many of these individuals, including those born abroad who have never lived in Afghanistan, are arriving with no resources and nowhere to stay. International organizations describe this as an unprecedented humanitarian crisis, as these families struggle to survive in a nation already facing severe poverty.
amharic: ፓኪስታን እና ኢራን በስደተኞች ላይ በወሰዱት ጥብቅ እርምጃ ከስድስት ሚሊዮን በላይ አፍጋኒስታውያን ወደ ሀገራቸው እንዲመለሱ ተገደዋል። ከእነዚህ መካከል አብዛኞቹ በውጭ ሀገር የተወለዱ እና አፍጋኒስታን ውስጥ ኖረው የማያውቁ በመሆናቸው፣ ምንም አይነት መተዳደሪያና መጠለያ ሳይኖራቸው ለከፋ ችግር ተጋልጠዋል። ዓለም አቀፍ ድርጅቶች ይህንን ታይቶ የማይታወቅ የሰብአዊ ቀውስ ሲሉ የገለጹት ሲሆን፣ ተመላሾቹ በከፍተኛ ድህነት ውስጥ በሚገኝ ሀገር ውስጥ ህልውናቸውን ለማስጠበቅ እየታገሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Pakiistaanii fi Iraan godaantota irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuu isaaniitiin, namoonni Afgaanistaan biiliyoona ja'a ol ta'an gara biyya isaanii deebi'uuf dirqamaniiru. Namoonni kun hedduun isaanii biyya alatti dhalatanii waan guddataniif, Afgaanistaan keessa jiraatanii hin beekan; amma garuu qabeenyaafi bakka buufatan tokko malee rakkina guddaa keessa jiru. title: Former gang leader found guilty of Tupac Shakur’s 1996 murder
english: A Las Vegas jury has convicted former gang leader Duane ‘Keffe D’ Davis for his role in the 1996 killing of rapper Tupac Shakur. Legal authorities established that Davis planned the retaliatory shooting and supplied the weapon used in the crime. The case was successfully reopened after Davis himself shared details about his involvement in the murder.
amharic: የላስ ቬጋስ ዳኞች የቀድሞ የጋንግ መሪ የነበረውን ዱዌን 'ኬፌ ዲ' ዴቪስን በ1996 ዓ.ም የራፐር ቱፓክ ሻኩርን ግድያ በመፈጸሙ ጥፋተኛ ብለውታል። አቃቤ ህግ እንደገለጸው ዴቪስ የበቀል ጥቃቱን በማቀድ ለተኩሱ ጥቅም ላይ የዋለውን መሳሪያ አቅራቢ ነበር። የጉዳዩ ምርመራ እንደገና የተከፈተው ዴቪስ ራሱ በግድያው ውስጥ ስላለው ተሳትፎ በሰጠው አስተያየት አማካኝነት ነው።
oromo: Mana murtii Las Vegasitti halkan tokko dura hogganaa garee seeraan alaa Duane ‘Keffe D’ Davis jedhamu, bara 1996 rapper Tupac Shakur ajjeesuu isaan itti murteesseera. Abbaan alangaa akka ibsetti, Davis haleellaa haaloo bahuuf yaadame sana qindeessuun alangee (qawwee) nama haleellaa raawwateef kenneera. Qorannoon dhimma kanaa kan deebi'ee baname, Davis mataan isaa waa'ee hirmaannaa isaa ajjeechaa kana keessatti himachuu isaan booda ture.

title: Algeria’s president seeks death penalty for those who start forest fires
english: Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune is pushing for the death penalty for individuals who intentionally start forest fires following a series of deadly blazes that killed at least 12 people. The president has ordered a legal review to amend the penal code, noting that the simultaneous start of several fires suggests criminal activity. Additionally, he has directed local authorities to provide rapid compensation to affected families and restore essential services like water and electricity to the impacted regions.

oromo: Pirezidaantiin Aljeeriyaa Abdelmaajid Tebbuun, ibidda bosonaa namoota 12 galaafate erga hordofee booda, namoota yaadanii ibidda kaasan irratti adabbii du'aa akka murteessuuf gaafatan. title: John Ternus to lead Apple into the age of AI
english: John Ternus is officially becoming Apple's new CEO, taking over for Tim Cook after his 15-year tenure. As an experienced hardware engineer, Ternus is expected to focus on product innovation to help the company catch up to competitors in the artificial intelligence sector. He will face immediate challenges, including navigating geopolitical tensions and managing the company's manufacturing reliance on China.

title: US brings back Russia’s Siluanov to G20 finance talks, angering Europe
english: The United States invited Russian Finance Minister Anton Siluanov to attend G20 financial meetings in North Carolina, marking his first in-person appearance at the forum since the invasion of Ukraine began. This decision has caused significant friction with European leaders, who criticized the move and expressed deep distrust toward Moscow. While the U.S. government defended the interaction as part of broader diplomatic efforts, European officials made their disapproval clear by distancing themselves from the Russian representative.

title: Toxic haze from Indonesian fires chokes Malaysia’s Sarawak
english: Severe haze caused by forest fires in Indonesia has blanketed Malaysia's Sarawak state, creating the region's most dangerous air quality crisis in ten years. The toxic smoke has led to a significant increase in respiratory and eye-related illnesses across the country, forcing the cancellation of major public events. Local authorities have recorded hazardous pollution levels, severely impacting daily life and the health of vulnerable residents.

title: Five vessels transit Hormuz Strait on Monday, remaining below average traffic
english: On Monday, only five commodity ships traveled through the Strait of Hormuz, maintaining a volume of traffic that remains below typical levels. Four of these vessels entered the channel, including three dry bulk carriers and an empty gas tanker, while one vessel departed. This data, provided by ship-tracking services, indicates stable but quiet maritime activity in the region.
amharic: ሰኞ ዕለት በአምስት የንግድ መርከቦች ብቻ የተከናወነው የሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ ጉዞ፣ ከወትሮው ያነሰ የትራፊክ እንቅስቃሴ መኖሩን ያሳያል። ከእነዚህ ውስጥ አራቱ መርከቦች ወደ ባህር ሰላጤው የገቡ ሲሆን አንዱ ደግሞ ወጥቷል። መረጃው እንደሚያመለክተው፣ የተገቡት መርከቦች ሶስት የደረቅ ጭነት ተሸካሚዎች እና አንድ ባዶ የጋዝ ታንከር ናቸው።
oromo: Dilbata darbe, markaleen gurgurtaa shan qofa ta'an daandii galaana Hormuz kan darban yoo ta'u, kunis hojii daandii galaanichaa kan yeroo hundaarraa kan gadii ta'uu agarsiisa. Markaleen kunneen keessaa afur gara keessa kan seenan yoo ta'u, tokko ammoo gadi ba'aniiru. Odeeffannoon kun akka ibsutti, markaleen seenan kunneen gosa gurguddaa sadii fi markala gaazii kan duwwaa ta'e qabatu.

title: Israeli troops advance further into Syria’s Daraa
english: Israeli military forces have been observed moving deeper into the Daraa province of Syria. Multiple armored vehicles and surveillance planes were seen operating near the village of Jumla. These activities indicate a significant expansion of their presence in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች ወደ ሶሪያው ዳራ ግዛት ጠልቀው እየገቡ መሆኑ ተዘግቧል። በጁምላ መንደር አካባቢ በርካታ የታጠቁ ተሽከርካሪዎች እና የስለላ አውሮፕላኖች ሲንቀሳቀሱ ታይተዋል። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ በአካባቢው የነበራቸውን መገኘት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንዳሰፋው ያሳያል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el gara kutaa biyya Suriyaa kan ta'e Daraa keessatti gara fuulduraatti deemaa akka jiran gabaafameera. Konkolaattoota waraanaa fi xiyyaarota qorannoo hedduutu baadiyaa Jumlaa jedhamtu biratti argameera. Tarkaanfiin kun haala jiru keessatti dhiibbaa fi humna isaanii akka babal'isanii jiran agarsiisa.

title: Vance says US now focused on free flow of commerce in Hormuz Strait
english: US Vice President JD Vance stated that Washington's current priority is protecting international trade routes through the Strait of Hormuz. He explained that recent military actions against Iranian forces were necessary to stop them from mining the waterway. Vance further criticized Iran's leadership, labeling their aggressive attempts to disrupt global oil and gas supplies as irrational and strategically unwise.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ ዋሽንግተን በአሁኑ ወቅት በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በኩል የንግድ እንቅስቃሴዎች ያለ ምንም እንቅፋት እንዲቀጥሉ ቅድሚያ ሰጥታ እየሰራች መሆኗን ገልጸዋል። በቅርቡ በአየርላንድ ላይ የተወሰደው ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ኢራን በውሃ መስመሩ ላይ ፈንጂ የመትከል ሙከራዋን ለማስቆም የታለመ መሆኑን አስረድተዋል። ቫንስ የኢራን መሪዎች የነዳጅ እና የጋዝ አቅርቦትን ለማስተጓጎል የሚያደርጉት ጥረት ስትራቴጂያዊ ጥበብ የጎደለው እና ምክንያታዊ ያልሆነ ድርጊት መሆኑን ተችተዋል።
oromo: Itti aanaa pirezidantii Ameerikaa JD Vance akka jedhanitti, xiyyeeffannoon Washington yeroo ammaa karaa markabaa Hormuz (Strait of Hormuz) daldalli akka walirraa hin cinne mirkaneessuu dha. Gochi waraanaa dhiyeenya kana Iran irratti raawwatame, Iran karaa bishaanii kana keessa boombii dhaabuuf yaalii goote dhaabsisuuf kan godhame ta'uu ibsaniiru. Vance hogganoonni Iran gabaa boba'aa fi gaazii addunyaa miidhuuf yaalii godhan gocha raawwatamu hin qabne fi mala kan hin qabne ta'uu balaaleffataniiru.

title: US Army Secretary Daniel Driscoll submits resignation, media reports say
english: US Army Secretary Daniel Driscoll has resigned from his position following a period of ongoing friction with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. While the White House praised his contributions to military readiness and foreign policy, it remains uncertain if his departure has been officially accepted. His resignation continues a trend of high-level personnel changes within the Pentagon under the current administration.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የጦር ኃይል ሚኒስትር ዳንኤል ድሪስኮል ከመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩ ፒት ሄግሴዝ ጋር በነበራቸው አለመግባባት ምክንያት ስልጣናቸውን መልቀቃቸው ተነግሯል። ዋይት ሀውስ ለሀገሪቱ ወታደራዊ ዝግጁነት ላደረጉት አስተዋጽኦ ምስጋና ቢሰጥም፣ መልቀቂያቸው በይፋ መጽደቁ እስካሁን ግልጽ አይደለም። ይህ ክስተት በአሁኑ አስተዳደር ስር በፔንታጎን ውስጥ እየተደረጉ ካሉ ተከታታይ ከፍተኛ የሹመት ለውጦች አንዱ ነው።
oromo: Ministeerri Waraana Ameerikaa Daani'eel Diriskool, ministeera ittisa biyyaa Piit Hegseet wajjin wal dhabdee turtee booda hojii gadhiisuu isaanii gabaafameera. Mana maree adii keessatti gumaacha isaan waraanaaf taasisan yoo dinqisiifatanillee, gadi lhiisuun isaanii sirritti fudhatamuun isaa ammatti hin mirkanaa'e. Kunis mootummaa amma jiru jalatti hoggantoonni olaanoo pentagonii irraa akkaataa itti gaggeeffamaa jiran keessaa tokko dha.

title: Three minors killed in Colombia armed group crackdown
english: A recent Colombian military airstrike targeting dissident FARC rebels in the Guaviare region resulted in the deaths of 10 people, including three teenagers. President Abelardo de la Espriella has intensified operations against these armed groups, which are increasingly using social media to recruit children into their ranks. Human Rights Watch reports that over 1,500 children have been recruited by such groups since 2021, often for dangerous combat roles.
amharic: በቅርቡ በኮሎምቢያ መንግስት በታጣቂዎች ላይ በተወሰደ የአየር ጥቃት ሶስት ታዳጊዎችን ጨምሮ አስር ሰዎች ተገድለዋል። ፕሬዝዳንት አቤላርዶ ዴ ላ ኤስፕሪዬላ የታጣቂ ቡድኖችን ለመደምሰስ ዘመቻቸውን ያጠናከሩ ሲሆን፣ እነዚህ ቡድኖች ህጻናትን ለማመልመል ማህበራዊ ሚዲያን እየተጠቀሙ መሆኑን መረጃዎች ያመለክታሉ። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች እንደዘገቡት ከ2021 ወዲህ ከ1,500 በላይ ህጻናት በታጣቂ ቡድኖች ተመልምለው ለከፍተኛ አደጋ ተጋልጠዋል።
oromo: Humni waraana Kolombiyaa gartuu finxaaleyyii FARC irratti qilleensa irraan haleellaa geggeesseen, dargaggoota sadii dabalatee namoonni kudhan du'aniiru. Pirezidaantiin biyyattii Abelardo de la Espriella gartuuwwan hidhattootaa irratti duula gaggeessaa jiran yoo ta'u, hidhattoonni kunneen miidiyaa hawaasaa fayyadamuun ijoollee akka waraanaatti malaammaluun isaanii ibsameera. Dhaabbanni mirga namoomaa akka gabaasetti, bara 2021 irraa eegalee ijoolleen kuma 1.5 ol ta'an gartuuwwan hidhattootaan akka malee qabamanii hojiiwwan balaa qaban keessatti bobbaafamaa jiru.

title: JERUSALEM DAILY: JOURNALISTS ATTACKED
english: In the occupied West Bank, journalists from NBC were targeted during attacks by Israeli settlers against Palestinians. Meanwhile, the conflict in Gaza continues with the tragic death of a three-year-old child following an Israeli airstrike. Additionally, Israeli Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir has drawn criticism for sharing AI-generated imagery featuring Palestinian detainees.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች በፍልስጤማውያን ላይ ጥቃት በሚሰነዝሩበት ወቅት የኤንቢሲ የዜና ቡድን አባላት ላይ ጥቃት ደርሷል። በሌላ በኩል በጋዛ በተፈፀመ የአየር ጥቃት የሶስት አመት ህጻን ህይወት አልፏል። ከዚህም በላይ የእስራኤሉ ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን-ግቪር በፍልስጤማውያን እስረኞች ላይ ያነጣጠረ ሰው ሰራሽ የማሰብ ችሎታ (AI) ምስል በመልቀቃቸው ትችት ገጥሟቸዋል።
oromo: Naannoo Zoonii Lixaa (West Bank) qabamee jiru keessatti, jiraattonni Israa'el namoota Falasxiin irratti haleellaa yeroo geessisan, garee oduu NBC irrattis haleellaan raawwatameera. Gam biraan immoo, haleellaa qilleensa irraa Gaazaa keessatti raawwatameen daa'imni waggaa sadii lubbuun ishee darbeera. Kana malees, ministirri Israa'el Itamar Ben-Gvir, hidhamtoota Falasxiin kan argisiisu bifa AI (Artificial Intelligence) tiin hojjetame gadi dhiisuun isaanii mormii guddaa kaaseera.

title: White House construction on $400m ballroom can go on, says US Supreme Court
english: The U.S. Supreme Court has ruled that a $400 million ballroom construction project at the White House may proceed while legal challenges continue. Although a preservation group argues the work lacks necessary congressional approval and historical oversight, the court majority prioritized national security claims and the government's authority. The project is expected to be largely completed within months, effectively bypassing a lower court's previous order to halt construction.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት በዋይት ሀውስ እየተካሄደ ያለው የ400 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ታላቅ የመስተንግዶ አዳራሽ ግንባታ የሕግ ክርክሩ እስኪጠናቀቅ ድረስ እንዲቀጥል ፈቅዷል። የቅርስ ጥበቃ ቡድኖች ግንባታው የኮንግረስ ፈቃድ አላገኘም በማለት ቢከራከሩም፣ ፍርድ ቤቱ ግን የብሔራዊ ደኅንነት ጉዳዮችን እና የመንግሥትን ስልጣን መነሻ በማድረግ ግንባታው እንዲቀጥል ወስኗል። በዚህ ውሳኔ ምክንያት አብዛኛው የግንባታ ሥራ በጥቂት ወራት ውስጥ የሚጠናቀቅ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ቀደም ሲል በታችኛው ፍርድ ቤት ታግዶ የነበረውን ፕሮጀክት እንደገና እንዲጀመር አድርጎታል።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa Ameerikaa ijaarsa galma guddaa kan galii doolaara miliyoona 400 waggaa galma Mana Maree (White House) keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru, mormiin seeraa osoo itti fufuu akka itti fufu hayyameera. Gareewwan seenaa eeguu fi tursiisuu, ijaarsi kun hayyama Kongireesii hin qabu jechuun mormaniyyuu, mana murtichi nageenya biyyoolessaa fi aangoo mootummaatti fayyadamuun ijaarsichi akka itti fufu murteesseera. Murtee kanaan, ijaarsi kun ji'oota muraasa keessatti kan xumuramu yoo ta'u, kunis murtee mana murtii gadii kanaan dura ijaarsicha dhaabuuf darbee ture kan haqee dha.

title: Poland opens terror probe into fire at factory supplying Ukraine drones
english: Polish authorities have launched a terrorism investigation following a suspicious fire at a defense factory that produces drone components for Ukraine. Officials are examining whether the incident, which occurred at the WB Electronics plant, was an act of foreign sabotage. This event follows a pattern of suspected Russian-backed interference targeting European nations that provide military support to Kyiv.
amharic: ለዩክሬን የድሮን መለዋወጫዎችን የሚያመርት የፖላንድ ፋብሪካ ላይ በደረሰ የእሳት አደጋ ዙሪያ የፖላንድ ባለስልጣናት የአሸባሪነት ምርመራ ጀምረዋል። በደብሊውቢ ኤሌክትሮኒክስ ፋብሪካ ላይ የደረሰው ይህ የእሳት አደጋ በውጭ ሀገር የስለላ ተቋማት የተፈጸመ የሴረኝነት ተግባር ስለመሆኑ እየተጣራ ነው። ይህ ክስተት ዩክሬንን የሚደግፉ የአውሮፓ ሀገራት ላይ በሩሲያ የሚፈጸሙ ናቸው ተብለው ከሚጠረጠሩ የጥፋት ድርጊቶች አንዱ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Mootummaan Poolaand, iddoo meeshaalee xiyyara gargaarsa biyya Yukreeniif oolchu oomishutti ibiddi erga ka’ee booda qorannoo shororkeessummaa jalqabdeetti. Iddoon WB Electronics jedhamu kun sababa ibiddichaan miidhamuu isaa hordofee, gochi kun ergamtoota biyya alaatiin kan raawwatame ta’uu isaa qulqulleessuuf qorannoon geggeeffamaa jira. Gochi kun biyyoota Yukreen gargaaraa jiran irratti garee Ruusiyaatiin raawwatamaa jira jedhamee shakkiin jiru keessaa isa tokko ta’uu isaa ibsameera.

title: Nepal rescuers blast hillside in search of hydropower workers as families wait anxiously
english: Rescue teams in Nepal are using explosives to break through mud-blocked tunnels at a hydropower plant site in a desperate effort to locate hundreds of workers trapped after catastrophic flooding. While international specialists have joined the search, families are growing increasingly frustrated by the slow pace of the operation as the overall national death toll climbs toward 1,000. Workers remain in critical danger as authorities race to supply oxygen into the subterranean structures, hoping to find survivors before the window for rescue closes.
amharic: በኔፓል የሚገኙ የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች በጎርፍ አደጋ ምክንያት በሃይድሮ ፓወር ጣቢያ ዋሻዎች ውስጥ የታሰሩ ሰራተኞችን ለማግኘት ፈንጂዎችን በመጠቀም ተራራውን እየሰነጠቁ ነው። በአለም አቀፍ ባለሙያዎች እየታገዘ ያለው ይህ የፍለጋ ስራ ቢቀጥልም፣ በአገሪቱ የደረሰው የሞት ቁጥር ወደ 1,000 እየተጠጋ በመሆኑ የጠፉ ሰዎች ቤተሰቦች በሂደቱ መዘግየት ከፍተኛ ቅሬታ እያሰሙ ነው። የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች በዋሻው ውስጥ ኦክሲጅን በማስገባት የተረፉ ሰዎችን ለመታደግ ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Gareen gargaarsaa Nepaal keessatti bal’inaan hidha humna bishaanii (hydropower) keessatti namoota duumansaan makamee hafe baasuuf dhagaa keessa dhuka’aan diiguun barbaacha cimaa geggeessaa jiru. Gareen biyyoota addunyaa irraa dhufan barbaacha kana irratti hirmaatus, lakkoofsi namoota du’anii 1,000 ga’aa waan jiruuf maatiin namoota dhabamanii dafii dhabeessa ta’uu hojii kanaatti gaddaniiru. Ogeeyyiin gargaarsaa balbala dhoqee cufamee jiru keessatti oksijiinii akka gahu gochuun, lubbuun jiraachuun namoota kanaa akka itti fufuuf carraaqqii taasisaa jiru.

title: US singer D4vd's celebrity lawyers withdraw from murder case
english: Celebrity defense attorneys representing US singer D4vd, whose legal name is David Anthony Burke, have stepped down from his murder trial. The 21-year-old musician, who is accused of murdering a 14-year-old girl, will now be represented by a public defender. While prosecutors are prepared to proceed, officials acknowledge that this legal change could potentially delay the upcoming court proceedings.
amharic: የአሜሪካዊው ዘፋኝ ዲፎርድ (D4vd) የህግ ጠበቆች ከነፍስ ግድያ ክሱ መውጣታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። በ14 ዓመቷ ወጣት ግድያ የተከሰሰው ዴቪድ አንቶኒ ቡርክ ከዚህ በኋላ በይፋዊ የህዝብ ጠበቃ ይወከላል። አቃቤ ህግ ለፍርድ ሂደቱ ዝግጁ መሆኑን ቢገልጽም፣ የጠበቆች ለውጥ የፍርድ ሂደቱ እንዲዘገይ ሊያደርግ እንደሚችል ተነግሯል።
oromo: Abukaatonni beekamoon sirbeessaawwan Ameerikaa D4vd jedhamuuf falmaa turan himata ajjeechaa isaa irraa gad-lakkisaniiru. Himatni ajjeechaa dargaggeettii umurii 14 irratti baname irra kan jiru dargaggeessi waggaa 21 kun, gara fuulduraatti abukaatoo mootummaan ramaduun kan itti fufu ta'a. Abbaan alangaa dhaddachaaf qophii ta'uu ibsatus, jijjiiramni abukaatoo kun adeemsa seeraa kan turu ta'uu malu.

title: ‘Nothing is usable’: Nepal residents return to flood-ravaged homes
english: Residents in Nepal's Devighat area are facing immense hardship as they return to homes destroyed by severe flooding. Many are struggling to recover belongings from thick layers of mud and wreckage left behind by the disaster. The death toll from the floods across Nepal and Tibet has surpassed 900, with thousands of people still reported missing.
amharic: በኔፓል ዲቪጋት አካባቢ የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች በከባድ ጎርፍ ለወደሙ ቤቶቻቸው በመመለስ ላይ ሲሆኑ ከፍተኛ ችግር ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። ብዙ ሰዎች በጎርፉ ከቤታቸው ውስጥ በገባው ጭቃ እና ፍርስራሽ ውስጥ ንብረቶቻቸውን ለማዳን እየታገሉ ነው። በኔፓል እና በቲቤት በደረሰው በዚህ አደጋ የሟቾች ቁጥር ከ900 በላይ የደረሰ ሲሆን በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ደግሞ የት እንደደረሱ አልታወቀም።
oromo: Namoonni naannoo Deevigaat, Neeppaal jiraatan, lolaa hamaa mana isaanii mancaase booda gara mana isaaniitti deebi'uun miidhaa guddaa keessa jiru. Namoonni hedduun lolaan gara mana isaaniitti gadi dhiise keessaa qabeenya isaanii baafachuuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru. Neeppaal fi Tiibetitti lolaa kanaan lubbuun namoota 900 ol darbeera, akkasumas namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawwaman amma ammaatti eessa akka jiran hin beekamu.

title: Ukrainians mourn community leader killed in Russian strike on Myla
english: The Dmytrivka community is grieving the loss of Taras Didych, a respected leader who died following a Russian missile strike on an ammunition depot in Myla. He was killed while attempting to assist victims of the attack. In total, 38 people lost their lives in this tragic incident.
amharic: የድሚትሪቭካ ማህበረሰብ በሚላ አካባቢ በሚገኝ የጦር መሳሪያ ማከማቻ ላይ በደረሰ የሩሲያ የአየር ጥቃት ህይወቱ ያለፈውን ታዋቂ መሪ ታራስ ዲዲች እያዘኑ ነው። ግለሰቡ ጥቃቱ በደረሰበት ወቅት ለተጎጂዎች እርዳታ ለመስጠት ሲሯሯጥ ነበር የሞተው። በአጠቃላይ በዚህ አሳዛኝ ድርጊት 38 ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን አጥተዋል።
oromo: Hawaasni Dmiitiriivka hogganaa kabajamaa Taaraas Diidiich jedhamu kan rukuttaa xiyyaaraa Ruusiyaan magaalaa Miilaa keessatti bakka meeshaa waraanaa irratti dhaqqabsiisteen du'eef gadda irra jiru. Hogganaan kun miidhamtoota gargaaruuf yommuu ariifatu balaa kanaan ajjeeffame. Waliigalaan namoonni 38 gocha suukanneessaa kanaan lubbuun darbeera.

title: What to know: US court hearing held for alleged Lockerbie bombmaker
english: A US court hearing is moving forward regarding Abu Agila Mohammad Mas’ud, a former Libyan intelligence officer accused of building the bomb used in the 1988 Pan Am Flight 103 attack over Lockerbie, Scotland. Although the trial was set to begin recently, a federal judge delayed the proceedings to allow the defense team to review newly discovered evidence. This case is significant as it marks the first time a suspect in this historical tragedy, which claimed 270 lives, has faced trial within the United States.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ በ1988 በስኮትላንድ በሎከርቢ ላይ የፓን አም በረራ 103ን የጣለውን ቦምብ በማምረት የተጠረጠሩት የቀድሞ የሊቢያ የስለላ ኦፊሰር አቡ አጊላ መሐመድ መስዑድ በዩኤስ የፍርድ ቤት ችሎት ቀርበዋል። የፌዴራል ዳኛው ችሎቱን ለጊዜው ያዘገዩት የመከላከያ ጠበቆች አዲስ የተገኙ መረጃዎችን እንዲመረምሩ ዕድል ለመስጠት ነው። ይህ ክስ ከሰላሳ ዓመታት በፊት 270 ሰዎችን ለቀጠፈው የሽብር ጥቃት በአሜሪካ ምድር የሚካሄድ የመጀመሪያው የፍርድ ሂደት ነው።
oromo: Abbaan alangaa Yunaayitid Isteets duraanii ajajaa basaastota Libiyaa kan ta'an Abu Agila Mohaammad Mas'ud, bara 1988 xiyyaarri Paan Aam 103 biyya Iskootland magaalaa Lokarbii gubbaatti akka kuufu bomii hojjetaniiru jedhee himateera. Abbaan seeraa tokko himatamaa kanaan dura erga qabamee booda, ragaalee haaraa argaman sakatta'uuf carraa akka argatan jechuun dhaddacha sana yeroof tureera. Namoonni 270 lubbuun isaanii darbe balaa kanaan, himatamni kun biyya Ameerikaa keessatti harka qabaachuu isaatiin seeraatti dhiyaachuu isaa kan agarsiisu ta'a.

title: Trump approval rating remains at record low, Reuters/Ipsos poll finds
english: A recent Reuters/Ipsos survey indicates that President Donald Trump's public approval rating has stayed at its historical low of 33 percent. This decline in popularity is linked to growing concerns over inflation and the ongoing conflict involving Iran. The findings are based on feedback from over 1,000 participants gathered across the United States.
amharic: አዲስ የተካሄደ የሮይተርስ/ኢፕሶስ ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው የፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ተወዳጅነት በታሪክ ዝቅተኛው ደረጃ የሆነው 33 በመቶ ላይ መሆኑን ነው። ይህ የድጋፍ መቀነስ ከኢኮኖሚ ግሽበት እና ከኢራን ጋር በተያያዘ ካለው ግጭት ጋር የተያያዘ ነው። ጥናቱ የተካሄደው በመላው አሜሪካ ከሚገኙ ከ1,000 በላይ ሰዎች አስተያየት በመሰብሰብ ነው።
oromo: Qorannoon dhiheenya Reuters/Ipsos gaggeesse akka argisiisutti, fudhatamummaan pirezidaant Doonaald Traamp gara 33%tti gadi bu'ee jira. Hir'inni deggersa kanaa rakkoo gatii gurguddaa dabaluu fi waldhabdee biyyattii Iran wajjin jiruun kan wal qabatu dha. Ragaan kun namoota Ameerikaa keessa jiraatan 1,000 ol ta'an irraa kan walitti qabame dha.

title: Saudi-backed LIV Golf preparing for bankruptcy filing
english: The Saudi-funded LIV Golf tour is preparing to file for bankruptcy as the kingdom withdraws its financial support following massive losses. The organization is currently offering players minimal settlement payouts while attempting to restructure into a new version of the league. This move is part of a broader trend of Saudi Arabia scaling back major projects due to economic pressures and the ongoing regional conflict.
amharic: በሳውዲ አረቢያ የሚደገፈው የሊቭ ጎልፍ ውድድር ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ኪሳራ በማጋጠሙ ምክንያት ኪሳራውን ለፍርድ ቤት ለማወጅ እየተዘጋጀ ነው። ድርጅቱ ለተጫዋቾች የገባውን የገንዘብ ቃል ኪዳን መፈጸም ባለመቻሉ አነስተኛ ክፍያዎችን እያቀረበ ሲሆን በሌላ በኩል ደግሞ ውድድሩን በአዲስ መልክ ለማደራጀት ጥረት እያደረገ ነው። ይህ ውሳኔ ሳውዲ አረቢያ በኢኮኖሚ ግፊት እና በክልሉ ባለው አለመረጋጋት ምክንያት ዋና ዋና ፕሮጀክቶቿን ከመቀነሷ ጋር ተያይዞ የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Sagantaan tapha golfii LIV Golf kan Saudii Arabaatiin deeggaramu, kasaaraa guddaa erga mudatee booda bankirootii ta'uuf qophii gochaa jira. Dhaabbatichi taphattootaaf kakuu kaffaltii durii raawwachuu waan dadhabeef, amma kaffaltii xiqqoo qofa dhiheessuun amala haaraatti of jijjiiruuf yaalaa jira. Tarkaanfiin kunis biyyattii keessatti dhiibbaa diinagdee fi waldhabdee naannoo sanaa irraa kan ka'e, pirojektoota gurguddoo hir'isuu ishee kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Trump's vow to escalate on Iran rings hollow amid warnings from top US generals
english: President Trump has threatened to retaliate aggressively against Iran following attacks on a U.S. base in Jordan. However, top military leaders have cautioned that a sustained large-scale conflict would hinder the ability of the United States to address other global security threats. Tensions have caused international oil prices to rise as the prospect of further escalation remains a significant concern.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በዮርዳኖስ በሚገኘው የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ ጥቃት ከተፈጸመ በኋላ በኢራን ላይ ጠንካራ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ ዝተዋል። ይሁን እንጂ ከፍተኛ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ መሪዎች ረጅም ጊዜ የሚፈጅ ጦርነት የአገሪቱ ሌሎች ዓለም አቀፍ የጸጥታ ስጋቶችን የመመከት አቅም እንደሚጎዳ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ግጭቱ ተባብሶ ሊቀጥል ይችላል በሚል ስጋት የዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ዋጋ ጭማሪ አሳይቷል።
oromo: Pirezidaant Traamp buufata waraana Ameerikaa kan Yordaanos keessatti argamu irratti erga haleellaan raawwatamee booda, Iraan irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf doorsisaniiru. Haata'u malee, ajootonni olaanoon waraana Ameerikaa, waraanni bal'aan dheeraa yoo itti fufe dandeettii Ameerikaan rakkoolee nageenyaa biroo addunyaa irratti qabdu akka laaffisu akeekkachiisaniiru. Gidduu kana rakkoon kun caalaatti hammaata soda jedhuun gatiin boba'aa addunyaa dabalee argama.

title: Oil prices jump amid resumption of US-Iran clashes
english: Global oil prices increased by over 2.5% following renewed military conflict between the United States and Iran. Tensions escalated after a US attack on Larak Island led to Iranian retaliation and the subsequent closure of the critical Strait of Hormuz. While crude prices reached $90.34 per barrel, they remain below the peak costs observed earlier this year.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል በተከሰተው አዲስ ወታደራዊ ግጭት ምክንያት የአለም የነዳጅ ዋጋ ከ2.5 በመቶ በላይ ጨምሯል። በአሜሪካ የላራክ ደሴት ላይ የተፈፀመውን ጥቃት ተከትሎ ኢራን ምላሽ የሰጠች ሲሆን፣ በዚህም ምክንያት ወሳኙ የሆርሙዝ የባህር መስመር ተዘግቷል። ምንም እንኳን የድፍድፍ ነዳጅ ዋጋ በአንድ በርሜል ወደ 90.34 ዶላር ቢደርስም፣ ይህ ዋጋ ከዚህ ቀደም በዓመቱ ከነበረው ከፍተኛ የዋጋ ንረት አሁንም ዝቅተኛ ነው።
oromo: Giddu galeessa lola mootummaa Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti deebi'ee dhohe hordofee gatiin boba'aa addunyaa dhibbeentaa 2.5 ol dabaleera. Ameerikaan odola Laarak haleeluushee fi Iraan deebii kennuushii hordofee, daandiin markabaa Hormuz cufameera. Gatiin boba'aa barmeela tokkoon gara doolaara 90.34 kan ga'e ta'us, gatiin kun waguma kana keessa bakka ol aanaa ga'ee ture irra kan gadi aane dha.

title: Trump's vow to escalate on Iran rings hollow amid warnings from top US generals
english: President Trump has promised a significant retaliation against Iran following missile strikes on a US base in Jordan, despite warnings from top military officials that a major, prolonged war is unsustainable. Senior generals have cautioned that the current military deployments, which shift resources away from other global regions, could severely limit the country's defense capabilities elsewhere. Consequently, despite the administration's aggressive rhetoric and rising oil prices, the military leadership remains deeply concerned about the long-term impact of further escalation.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በዮርዳኖስ በሚገኘው የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ ጥቃት ከተፈጸመ በኋላ ኢራን ላይ ጠንካራ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ ቃል ገብተዋል። ሆኖም ከፍተኛ የጦር መሪዎች እንደገለጹት፣ ኢራን ጋር የሚደረግ ረጅም እና ሰፊ ጦርነት የአሜሪካን አቅም የሚጎዳ በመሆኑ ዘላቂነት እንደሌለው አስጠንቅቀዋል። አሁን ያለው የወታደራዊ ሀብት ዝውውር ለሌሎች የአለም ክፍሎች ያለውን የደህንነት ስጋት እንደሚጨምር በመግለጽ፣ አስተዳደሩ ከሚያደርገው የዛቻ ንግግር በተቃራኒ ወታደራዊ አመራሩ የጦርነቱን መስፋፋት እንደማይደግፉ ተነግሯል።
oromo: Prezidaant tiraamp weerara buufata waraana Ameerika kan Yordaanos keessatti raawwatame hordofee Iran irratti tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhatan waadaa galan. Ta'us, ajajoonni waraanaa olaanoon akka akeekkachiisanitti, waraanni bal'aan Iran waliin godhamu yeroo dheeraaf itti fufuun isaa dandeettii waraana Ameerikaa iddoo biroo irratti miidhuu danda'a. Qondaalonni kunneen mootummaan ibsa cimaa kennus, guddinni waraanaa kun naannolee biroo irratti qophii waraana Ameerikaa akka laaffisu yaaddoo qabu ibsaniiru.

title: Man arrested after Swiss rave shooting that killed woman
english: A 43-year-old Swiss man has been taken into custody following a fatal shooting at a techno dance party in the town of Aarau. The attack resulted in the death of a 22-year-old Italian woman and left five other attendees with injuries. Authorities conducted a day-long search and currently believe the suspect acted independently while they continue to investigate his motives.
amharic: በስዊዘርላንድ አራው ከተማ በተካሄደ የቴክኖ ሙዚቃ ድግስ ላይ በተፈጸመ ተኩስ አንድ የ43 ዓመት ስዊዘርላንዳዊ ሰው በቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል። በዚሁ ጥቃት የ22 ዓመቷ ጣሊያናዊት ሴት ህይወት ሲያልፍ፣ ሌሎች አምስት ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ፖሊስ ለቀናት ያህል ባካሄደው ፍለጋ ተጠርጣሪውን በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋለ ሲሆን፣ ድርጊቱን የፈጸመው ብቻውን እንደሆነ እና የምርመራ ሂደቱ መቀጠሉን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Magala Aarau kan jedhamtu keessatti namni lammii Siwiizerlaandi waggaa 43 tokko guyyaa har'aa to'annoo jala ooleera. Namichi kun qophii muzikii 'techno' irratti dhukaasa banuun dubartii lammii Xaaliyaanii waggaa 22 taate ajjeeseera, namoonni shan biroo immoo madaa'aniiru. Poolisiin sa'aatii 24 guutuu hordoffii godheen booda namicha qabachuu isaa fi namichi kun kophaa isaa akka raawwate shakkamaa akka jiru ibseera.

title: South African airline defends low-altitude aerial stunt over packed stadium
english: Airlink is defending a recent low-altitude flyover where two of its jets passed extremely close to a packed rugby stadium in Cape Town before a match between South Africa and New Zealand. While some critics labeled the maneuver as reckless, the airline insisted the stunt was carefully planned and executed by highly skilled pilots in accordance with aviation safety approvals. Many spectators and officials praised the display as a demonstration of expert flying and national pride.
amharic: ኤርሊንክ በተባለው አየር መንገድ የሁለት አውሮፕላኖቹ በኬፕታውን ስታዲየም ላይ በዝቅተኛ ከፍታ መብረር ትክክል እንደነበር በመግለጽ ተከላክሏል። በደቡብ አፍሪካ እና በኒውዚላንድ የራግቢ ጨዋታ መክፈቻ ላይ የተደረገው ይህ ድርጊት አደገኛ ነው የሚል ትችት ቢሰነዘርበትም፣ አየር መንገዱ የበረራው እቅድ በባለሙያዎች የተጠና እና አስፈላጊውን የደህንነት ፈቃድ ያገኘ መሆኑን አስታውቋል። በርካታ ታዳሚዎችና የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት ግን የበረራውን ትክክለኛነት በማድነቅ ለሀገራዊ ኩራት እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Airlink balaliin xiyyaara isaa lamaan dirree tapha kubbaa miilaa Keep Taawunitti namoota guutuu keessa darbe akka sagantaa sirriitti qophaa'ee fi sadarkaa nageenyaa eeggatee kan raawwatame ta'uu ibsuun falmeera. Gochi kun tapha Raagbii biyyoota Afrikaa Kibbaa fi Niiw Ziilaand gidduutti ta'e dura kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, namoonni tokko tokko gochicha balaa kan qabu jechuun komatanis, kampaniin sun garuu balaliiftonni isaanii ogeeyyota gahumsa qaban ta'uu ibseera. Hawaasni fi qondaalonni biyyattii hedduun garuu balaliicha kan dinqisiifatan yoo ta'u, kunis boona biyyaa akka ta'e dubbataniiru.

title: The jury's options in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial
english: Lindsay Clancy is on trial for killing her three children in Massachusetts, a case centered on whether she was suffering from severe postpartum psychosis at the time. While she admits to the killings, the defense argues she lacked criminal responsibility due to her mental state, whereas the prosecution claims she acted with clear intent. The jury must now decide if she is guilty of first-degree murder, which carries a life sentence, or not guilty by reason of insanity, which would result in hospital confinement.
amharic: ሊንዚ ክላንሲ በስ Massachusetts ግዛት ሶስት ልጆቿን በመግደሏ ምክንያት በችሎት ቀርባለች። ክርክሩ ያተኮረው ድርጊቱን በፈጸመችበት ወቅት በአእምሮ ህመም (postpartum psychosis) ምክንያት ራሷን መቆጣጠር ትችል እንደነበር ነው። ዓቃቤ ህግ ግድያው የታቀደ መሆኑን ሲከራከር፣ የመከላከያ ጠበቆቿ ግን የአእምሮ ችግር እንደነበረባት ይናገራሉ። ዳኞች ግለሰቧ ጥፋተኛ ናት ብለው ከወሰኑ የዕድሜ ልክ እስራት ሊጠብቃት ይችላል፣ አለበለዚያ ግን በአእምሮ ህመም ምክንያት ንፁህ ተብላ በህክምና ተቋም ውስጥ እንድትታሰር ሊወሰን ይችላል።
oromo: ሊንዚ ክላንሲ በግዛተ ማሳቹሴትስ ልጆቿን ሶስቱን በመግደሏ ምክንያት በፍርድ ቤት እየታየች ነው። ክርክሩ ያተኮረው ግድያውን በፈጸመችበት ወቅት በወሊድ ምክንያት በሚመጣ የአእምሮ ህመም (postpartum psychosis) ተጠቅታ ነበር ወይስ አልነበረችም በሚለው ላይ ነው። አቃቤ ህግ ድርጊቱ የታቀደ ነው ሲል፣ የተከሳሿ ጠበቆች ግን የአእምሮ ጤንነቷ የተጎዳ በመሆኑ ለድርጊቷ ሀላፊነት መውሰድ እንደማትችል ይከራከራሉ። የዳኞች ኮሚቴው ጥፋተኛ ናት ብሎ ከወሰነ የዕድሜ ልክ እስራት ሊፈረድባት ይችላል፣ ወይም በአእምሮ ህመም ምክንያት ጥፋተኛ አይደለችም ተብላ በሆስፒታል እንድትቆይ ሊወሰን ይችላል።

title: 'She slipped out of my hand' - children missing after ferry sinks off northern Cyprus
english: A passenger ferry traveling from northern Cyprus to Turkey capsized on Sunday during rough weather, resulting in at least eight deaths and 20 people reported missing. Among those missing are the two children of a couple who survived the sinking but were unable to hold onto them due to slippery, oil-covered surfaces. Authorities have since arrested the ship’s captain and seven other crew members as rescue operations continue.
amharic: ከሰሜን ሳይፕረስ ወደ ቱርክ ሲጓዝ የነበረ የንግድ መርከብ እሁድ ዕለት በነበረው መጥፎ የአየር ሁኔታ ምክንያት ተገልብጦ ቢያንስ ስምንት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፤ ሌሎች 20 ሰዎች ደግሞ የገቡበት አልታወቀም። ከተጎጂዎቹ መካከል በጉዞው ላይ የነበሩ ጥንዶች ልጆቻቸው በመርከቡ ላይ በነበረው የዘይት ቅባት ምክንያት ከእጃቸው በማምለጣቸው ሊያድኗቸው አልቻሉም። የሀገሪቱ ባለስልጣናት የመርከቧን ካፒቴን ጨምሮ ስምንት የሰራተኛ አባላትን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል፤ የፍለጋ ስራውም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Dooniin abbaa hirree tokko gara Turkii imalaa turte Dilbata darbe qilleensa hamaa keessatti garagaltee lubbuun namoota saddeet darbuun kan beekame yoo ta'u, namoonni 20 ammoo hanga ammaatti bakka bu'an hin beekamu. Namoota bade keessaa ijoolleen lama kanneen maatii tokkoo ta'an kan argaman yoo ta'u, haati isaanii sababa boba'aa dhangala'een ijoollee ishee harkaa baasuu hin dandeenye. Bulchiinsi naannichaa kabtaanii doonichaa fi hojjettoota isaa kan biroo saddeet qabee kan hidhe yoo ta'u, hojiin barbaacha ijoollee fi namoota biroo itti fufee jira.

title: Is Trump testing the limits of US power?
english: Experts are analyzing how Donald Trump's policies, particularly his approach to the conflict with Iran, might influence the upcoming US midterm elections. While some believe shifting the focus to economic pressure is a strategic move to downplay the war, others suggest that rising costs are a major concern for voters. The outcome remains uncertain as both political parties face the impact of these policies on their electoral prospects.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ እየቀረበ ባለበት ወቅት የዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር ፖሊሲዎች በተለይም ከኢራን ጋር ያለው ውዝግብ በምርጫው ላይ የሚያሳድረው ተጽዕኖ በባለሙያዎች እየተገመገመ ነው። አንዳንድ ተንታኞች ትራምፕ ጦርነቱን ወደ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ግፊት የቀየሩት ከምርጫው በፊት የህዝቡን ትኩረት ለመቀየር ነው ብለው ያምናሉ። ሆኖም እየጨመረ የመጣው የኑሮ ውድነት በምራጮች ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት በመፍጠሩ በምርጫ ውጤቱ ላይ ተጽዕኖ ሊያሳድር እንደሚችል ተገልጿል።
oromo: Ogeeyyonni siyaasaa imaammata Donald Trump, keessattuu walitti buiinsa Iran waliin qaban filannoo giddu galeessa Ameerikaa dhufu irratti dhiibbaa akkamii akka qabaatu qorachaa jiru. Tokko tokko akka jedhanitti, Trump dhimma waraanaa gara dhimma diinagdeetti jijjiiruun isaa xiyyeeffannoo filannoo irraa deebisuuf kan yaadame dha. Haa ta'u malee, gatiin meeshaalee dabaluun isaa yaaddoo guddaa ummataa ta'ee waan jiruuf, kunis bu'aa filannichaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuu danda'a.

title: Why has Greece signed a $3.5bn missile deal with Israel?
english: Greece has signed a $3.5 billion agreement to purchase an advanced air defense system from Israel, marking the largest defense deal between the two nations. Known as the 'Achilles Shield,' this project is a central component of Greece's long-term military modernization plan to strengthen its security by 2030. The move comes amid rising tensions with Turkiye and regional concerns over the ongoing conflict involving Iran and its allies.
amharic: ግሪክ ከእስራኤል የ3.5 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ዋጋ ያለው ዘመናዊ የአየር መከላከያ ስርዓት ለመግዛት ትልቁን የመከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርማለች። 'አኪሊስ ሺልድ' ተብሎ የሚጠራው ይህ ፕሮጀክት ግሪክ እስከ 2030 ድረስ ወታደራዊ አቅሟን ለማዘመን ከያዘችው እቅድ ዋና አካል ነው። ይህ እርምጃ ከቱርክ ጋር ያለው የሻከረ ግንኙነት እና በኢራን እና አጋሮቿ መካከል እየተካሄደ ባለው ግጭት ሳቢያ የተፈጠረውን የደህንነት ስጋት ለመከላከል የታለመ ነው።
oromo: Giriikiin sirna ittisa qilleensaa ammayyaa Israa'el irraa bituuf walii galtee biyyoota lamaan gidduutti godhame keessaa isa guddaa ta'e kan gatiin isaa biliyoona 3.5 dolaara ta'e mallatteessiteetti. 'Achiiliis Shiild' jedhamee kan beekamu sagantaan kun, Giriikiin hanga bara 2030tti humna waraana ishee ammayyeessuuf karoorfatte keessaa isa guddaadha. Tarkaanfiin kunis wal dhabdee Turkii wajjin qabdu fi sodaa naannoo sanaa kan irratti hunda'ee kan fudhatamedha.

title: Jason Arday mural displayed at London’s Notting Hill Carnival
english: A mural honoring the late Cambridge professor Jason Arday has been unveiled at the Notting Hill Carnival in London. The artwork incorporates testimonials from students to push back against accusations of plagiarism made by Nathan Cofnas. This display serves as a public tribute to the professor following the significant media scrutiny he faced before his death.
amharic: የሟቹ የካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ፕሮፌሰር የጄሰን አርዳይ መታሰቢያ ግድግዳ ስዕል በለንደን ኖቲንግ ሂል ካርኒቫል ላይ ታይቷል። ስራው በናታን ኮፍናስ የቀረበበትን የኮፒራይት ወይም የጥቅስ ስርቆት ክስ በመቃወም የተማሪዎችን ምስክርነት ያካተተ ነው። ይህ ስዕል ፕሮፌሰሩ ከማረፋቸው በፊት በነበረው ከፍተኛ የሚዲያ ጫና ውስጥ፣ ለስራቸው ክብር ለመስጠት የታለመ ነው።
oromo: Suurreen yaadannoo piroofeesara Yuunivarsiitii Kaambirijii kan ta'an Jason Arday, ayyaana Notting Hill Carnival kan Landan irratti ifoomeera. Suurreen kun himata hatuu barreeffamaa (plagiarism) Nathan Cofnas irraa isaan mudatee ture kan mormu ta'ee, ragaalee barattootaa qabateera. Hojiin kun, piroofeesarichi osoo hin du'in dura miidiyaalee irratti dhiibbaa cimaa isaan mudate booda, yaadannoo isaaniif godhame dha.

title: War and heat: Why are wheat prices soaring?
english: Global wheat prices have spiked due to a combination of intensifying military attacks on Black Sea grain infrastructure and severe drought conditions affecting major producers. Both Russia and Ukraine are targeting each other's shipping terminals, which has severely disrupted export logistics and increased costs. These logistical challenges, worsened by climate-related harvest failures in regions like South Africa, are raising significant concerns about global food security.
amharic: በሩሲያ እና ዩክሬን መካከል እየተካሄደ ባለው ጦርነት የጥቁር ባህር የሰብል መጓጓዣ ጣቢያዎች ላይ የሚሰነዘሩ ጥቃቶች በመባባሳቸው የስንዴ ዋጋ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ጨምሯል። ከጦርነቱ በተጨማሪ በአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ምክንያት በተከሰተው ድርቅ የምርት መቀነስ መፈጠሩ ለዋጋ ጭማሪው ሌላው ምክንያት ሆኗል። እነዚህ የሎጂስቲክስ ችግሮች እና የምርት እጥረት በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የረሃብ ስጋት እንዲጨምር እያደረጉ ይገኛል።
oromo: Gatiin qamadii addunyaa irratti dabaluun isaa, waraana Raashiyaafi Yukreen jidduutti adeemaa jiruun buufataalee gabaa midhaanii irratti miidhaan gahuu fi jijjiirama qilleensaan walqabatee omishni hir'achuu isaatiin kan ka'e dha. Biyyoonni lamaanuu buufataalee gabaa midhaanii irratti haleellaa geggeessaa jiruun geejjiba midhaanii addaan kutee jira. Rakkoon dhiyeessii fi omisha midhaanii kunis addunyaa irratti soda nyaataa fi beelaa babal'isaa jira.

title: Sleeping in on weekends is good for the heart: What research has shown
english: A recent seven-year study of over 40,000 adults suggests that sleeping an extra hour or two on weekends can help lower the risk of high blood pressure. Researchers found that this recovery sleep helps the body relax after a stressful workweek, potentially reducing the likelihood of hypertension by up to 9 percent. Experts suggest that people should not feel guilty about catching up on sleep, as it acts as a helpful benefit for heart health.
amharic: ከ40,000 በላይ አዋቂዎች ላይ ለሰባት ዓመታት የተደረገ አዲስ ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው ቅዳሜና እሁድ ተጨማሪ አንድ ወይም ሁለት ሰዓት መተኛት የደም ግፊትን የመጋለጥ እድልን ይቀንሳል። ተመራማሪዎች ይህ የእረፍት እንቅልፍ ከስራ ሳምንት በኋላ ሰውነት እንዲዝናና እና የደም ግፊት ችግርን እስከ ዘጠኝ በመቶ እንዲቀንስ እንደሚረዳ ደርሰውበታል። በቂ እንቅልፍ ማግኘት ለልብ ጤንነት ጠቃሚ ስለሆነ ሰዎች ተጨማሪ መተኛታቸውን እንደ ስንፍና ሊቆጥሩት አይገባም ብለዋል ተመራማሪዎቹ።
oromo: Qorannoon waggoota torbaaf namoota 40,000 ol irratti gaggeeffame akka agarsiisutti, guyyoota boqonnaatti sa'aatii tokko ykn lama dabalanii rafuun dhiibbaa dhiigaa hir'isuuf gargaara. Qorattoonni akka jedhanitti, hirribni dabalataa kun qaamni torbee hojiin booda akka tasgabboofatu taasisee, carraa dhibee dhiibbaa dhiigaa hanga sagaltamatti hir'isuu danda'a. Hirribni gahaa ta'e fayyummaa onneetiif barbaachisaa waan ta'eef, namoonni yeroo dabalanii rafan akka dadhabinaatti ykn yakkaatti ilaaluu hin qaban.

title: Morocco's revived claim to Ceuta and Melilla is not a demand for decolonisation
english: A surge of migrants reaching the Spanish-controlled territories of Ceuta and Melilla has reignited Morocco's long-standing push for these areas to be returned. Spain has consistently refused to negotiate the status of these cities, which it has held for centuries. This regional tension is further complicated by diplomatic friction between Spain and Italy regarding border controls and Morocco’s evolving geopolitical alliances.
amharic: ወደ ስፔን ቁጥጥር ስር ባሉ ሴኡታ እና ሜሊላ ከተሞች በርካታ ስደተኞች መግባታቸው፣ ሞሮኮ እነዚህን ግዛቶች እንዲመለሱላት የምታቀርበውን ጥያቄ እንደገና አቀጣጥሎታል። ስፔን ለብዙ መቶ ዓመታት የያዘቻቸውን እነዚህን ከተሞች ጉዳይ ለመወያየት ፈቃደኛ አልሆነችም። በስፔን እና በጣሊያን መካከል በድንበር ቁጥጥር ላይ የተፈጠረው አለመግባባት እና የሞሮኮ የውጭ ግንኙነት ለውጦች ሁኔታውን ይበልጥ ውስብስብ አድርገውታል።
oromo: Godaanstonni hedduun gara magaalota Spain to'annoo jala jiran kanneen akka Ceuta fi Melilla gahuun, Morocco magaalota kana akka of harka galchituuf gaaffii ishee durii akka haaromsitu taasiseera. Spain magaalota jaarraawwan hedduuf qabattee turte kana irratti mari'achuuf gonkumaa hin hayyamne. Wal dhabdeen daangaa gidduu Spain fi Italy akkasumas walitti dhufeenyi siyaasaa Morocco addunyaa waliin qabdu rakkoo kana caalaatti xaxamaa taasiseera.

title: Senior Iranian source warns of harsher response to further US attacks
english: A top Iranian official described recent military tensions with the United States as limited but warned of severe consequences if hostilities continue. Tehran also cautioned that it might impose stricter control over shipping in the Strait of Hormuz to punish vessels that disregard its regulations. The official emphasized that Iran possesses the military capability to strike any target across the region if provoked further.
amharic: አንድ ከፍተኛ የኢራን ባለስልጣን ከአሜሪካ ጋር የተፈጠረውን የቅርብ ጊዜ ግጭት ውስን እንደሆነ ገልጸው፣ ተጨማሪ ጥቃቶች ከተፈጸሙ ጠንካራ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ኢራን በሆርሙዝ የባህር ዳርቻ ደንቦቿን የሚጥሱ መርከቦች ላይ ጥብቅ ቁጥጥር እንደምታደርግም አስታውቃለች። በተጨማሪም፣ ኢራን በአካባቢው የሚገኙ ማንኛውንም ኢላማዎች የመምታት አቅም እንዳላት ባለስልጣኑ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni olaanoon Iraan walitti bu'iinsa dhihoo kana Ameerikaa wajjin uumame hanga ammaatti kan daangeffame ta'uu ibsanii, yoo weerarri itti fufe garuu tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf qophiidha jedhaniiru. Iraan dooniiwwan daandii galaana Hormuz keessa darban irratti heera ishee kanneen cabsan irratti tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhattu akeekkachiisteetti. Kana malees, Iraan naannichatti bakka barbaadde kamiyyuu rukutuuf humna guutuu akka qabdu hoggantoonni kun beeksisaniiru.

title: Turkey says roadmap being prepared to expand Mecca defence alliance
english: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan are developing a formal process to invite more nations to join their recently formed defence alliance. This security pact, established in early August, aims to address rising regional instability and strengthen cooperation among the three member states. Officials are currently creating a roadmap to outline how other countries can participate in this strategic partnership.
amharic: ቱርክ፣ ሳውዲ አረቢያ እና ፓኪስታን በቅርቡ የመሰረቱት የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት ሌሎች ሀገራት እንዲቀላቀሉ የሚያስችል የአሰራር ሂደት እየቀረጹ ነው። ይህ በነሀሴ ወር መጀመሪያ ላይ የተፈረመው ስምምነት፣ በክልሉ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የጸጥታ ስጋት ለመከላከል ያለመ ነው። ሀገራቱ አዳዲስ አባል ሀገራት በህብረቱ ውስጥ እንዴት እንደሚካተቱ የሚገልጽ ዝርዝር የሥራ መመሪያ እያዘጋጁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Turkiin, Sa'udii Arabiyaafi Paakistaan walta'insa ittisaa isaan dhiheenya kana uumatanitti biyyoota biroo akka dabalamaniif karaa banuuf hojjechaa jiru. Waliigalteen nageenyaa ji'a Hagayyaa keessa mallatteeffame kun, rakkoolee nageenyaa naannichatti uumamaa jiran furuuf kan gargaaruudha. Biyyoonni sadan kun biyyoonni biroo akkamitti miseensa ta'uu akka danda'an qajeelfama guddinaa (roadmap) qopheessaa jiru.

title: Pentagon signs seven-year deals to boost missile production
english: The U.S. Department of Defense has finalized seven-year contracts with Lockheed Martin and General Dynamics to ramp up the manufacturing of missile components. This initiative focuses on speeding up the output and supply of essential parts for the THAAD and Patriot defense systems. These measures are being taken to address the rising global demand for missile defense caused by ongoing international tensions and security threats.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ከሎክሂድ ማርቲን እና ከጄኔራል ዳይናሚክስ ጋር የሚሳኤል መለዋወጫዎችን ምርት ለማሳደግ የሰባት ዓመት ስምምነት ተፈራርሟል። ይህ ዕቅድ ለታድ (THAAD) እና ለፓትሪዮት መከላከያ ሥርዓቶች የሚያስፈልጉ አስፈላጊ ክፍሎችን አቅርቦት ለማፋጠን ያለመ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ እየጨመረ የመጣውን የሚሳኤል መከላከያ ፍላጎት እና የጸጥታ ስጋቶችን ለመቋቋም ነው።
oromo: Ministeerri ittisa biyyaa Amerikaa, kutaalee xiyyaara kombata (missile) oomishuuf Lockheed Martin fi General Dynamics waliin waliigaltee waggaa torbaallee mallatteesseera. Karoorri kun meeshaalee barbaachisoo ta'an kanneen sirna ittisa THAAD fi Patriot keessatti gargaaran saffisiisanii oomishuuf gargaara. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame fedhii sirna ittisa xiyyaara kombataa addunyaa irratti dabalaa dhufe fi rakkoolee nageenyaa mudataa jiran furuufi.

title: Israeli army shoots first and finds reasons to justify mass killings later, veterans group says
english: The Israeli veterans' group Breaking the Silence has accused the military of killing Palestinians first and searching for justifications afterwards. Executive director Nadav Weiman claims the army labels victims as Hamas members post-incident to legitimize civilian deaths to the international community. He describes this as a process of retrospective incrimination, where intelligence is used to build a case only after lethal force has been applied.
amharic: የእስራኤል የቀድሞ ወታደሮች ቡድን የሆነው 'ብሬኪንግ ዘ ሳይለንስ'፣ የእስራኤል ጦር ፍልስጤማውያንን ከገደለ በኋላ ድርጊቱን ለማጽደቅ ምክንያት እንደሚፈልግ ከሷል። የቡድኑ ዋና ዳይሬክተር ናዳቭ ዋይማን እንደገለጹት፣ ጦሩ ንጹሃን ዜጎችን ከገደለ በኋላ አለም አቀፍ ተቀባይነት ለማግኘት ሲል የሟቾችን ማንነት ከሃማስ ጋር በማያያዝ ማመካኛ እንደሚፈልግ ተናግረዋል። ይህ አካሄድ ግድያው ከተፈጸመ በኋላ በረቀቀ መንገድ ማስረጃዎችን በመፈለግ ጦርነቱን ህጋዊ ለማስመሰል የሚደረግ ጥረት መሆኑን አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Garee waraana Israa'el durii 'Breaking the Silence' jedhamu, waraanni biyyattii uummata Falasxiin erga ajjeese booda sababa ittiin of-qolchu akka barbaadu himateera. Hoggantoonni garee kanaa akka jedhanitti, waraanni Israa'el namoota ajjeefaman booda akka miseensa Haamaasitti maqaa waamuun, gochicha addunyaa biratti fudhatama akka argatuuf yaala. Mala 'himata booddee' jedhamu kanaan, waraanni erga ajjeechaa raawwatee booda, gochi isaa akka seera qabeessa ta'etti akka fudhatamuuf ragaa sobaa ykn walitti dhufeenya qabatamaa hin taane barbaada.

title: FIFA president Infantino ‘must go’, says former UEFA boss Platini
english: Former UEFA president Michel Platini has publicly called for FIFA head Gianni Infantino to step down due to multiple administrative failures and ethical concerns. Platini criticized Infantino for disregarding the official rules of football, specifically citing problematic commercial breaks and political interference during the recent World Cup. Faced with mounting pressure and accusations of mismanagement, Infantino is now encountering opposition from several major regional football organizations ahead of his re-election bid.
amharic: የቀድሞው የUEFA ፕሬዝዳንት ሚሼል ፕላቲኒ የፊፋው መሪ ጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ አስተዳደራዊ ውድቀቶችን እና የስነ-ምግባር ችግሮችን በመጥቀስ ከስልጣናቸው እንዲለቁ ጠይቀዋል። ፕላቲኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ የእግር ኳስ ህጎችን በመጣስ በተለይም በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የዓለም ዋንጫ ላይ የንግድ ማስታወቂያዎችን እና የፖለቲካ ጣልቃ ገብነትን በመፍቀዳቸው ክፉኛ ተቸዋል። ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ እና የመልካም አስተዳደር እጦት ክሶች የገጠሙት ኢንፋንቲኖ፣ ከሚቀጥለው ምርጫ በፊት በበርካታ ዓለም አቀፍ የእግር ኳስ ማህበራት ተቃውሞ እየገጠመው ይገኛል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin duraanii UEFA Mishel Pilaatiniin, hooggantoota FIFA Jiyaanii Infaantinoon rakkoolee bulchiinsaafi hanqina amalaa agarsiisaniin qabaman jechuun aangoo gadi dhiisuu akka qaban gaafataniiru. Pilaatiniin, Infaantinoon seera kubbaa miillaa kabajuu dhiisuun, keessattuu tapha waancaa addunyaa darbe irratti beeksisa daldalaa fi giddu-seentummaa siyaasaa akka hayyaman ibsaniiru. Dhiibbaa fi himannaa sirnaan bulchuu dhabuu irratti banameen kanneen, Infaantinoon filannoo dhufu dura dhaabbilee kubbaa miillaa gurguddoo irraa mormii cimaan mudachaa jiru.

title: Aston Villa vs Arsenal: Premier League – prediction, team news, lineups
english: Arsenal and Aston Villa are set to face off in a high-profile Premier League match at Villa Park. While defending champions Arsenal enter the game with strong momentum after early-season victories, Aston Villa is struggling following a heavy opening loss and several key player departures. The game features two top-tier Spanish managers competing in a fixture that has become a highlight of the English football calendar.
amharic: አርሰናል እና አስቶን ቪላ በቪላ ፓርክ ለሚደረገው የፕሪሚየር ሊግ ጨዋታ ተዘጋጅተዋል። የሊጉ ሻምፒዮኑ አርሰናል በውድድሩ መጀመሪያ ላይ ባሳየው ጥሩ ብቃት ጨዋታውን በከፍተኛ ተስፋ ሲጀምር፣ አስቶን ቪላ ግን ከባድ ሽንፈት እና ተጫዋቾቻቸውን በማጣታቸው ምክንያት አስቸጋሪ ጊዜ እያሳለፈ ነው። ሁለቱ ስፔናዊ አሰልጣኞች የሚመሩት ይህ ጨዋታ በእንግሊዝ እግር ኳስ ውስጥ ትልቅ ግምት የሚሰጠው ነው።
oromo: Arsenal fi Aston Villa guyyaa har'aa viilaa paarkitti tapha Premier League irratti wal morkatu. Arsenal qophii gaarii taasisuun injifannoo argachaa kan jirtu yoo ta'u, Aston Villa garuu injifannoo malee fi gurgurtaa taphattootaa booda rakkoo keessa jirti. Leenjistonni lamaan isaanuu Ispeen irraa dhufan kun, tapha kana qophii guddaa taasisuun isaan eeggatu.

title: Tennis great Djokovic exits US Open in first round amid tears and pain
english: Tennis legend Novak Djokovic suffered a surprising first-round exit at the US Open after a difficult five-set loss to Mariano Navone. The 39-year-old star struggled significantly with physical illness, cramping, and severe back pain throughout the lengthy match. This defeat marks his earliest exit from the tournament in twenty years, leaving many to wonder if the 24-time Grand Slam champion will continue his professional career.
amharic: የቴኒስ ኮከቡ ኖቫክ ጆኮቪች በማሪያኖ ናቮን ተሸንፎ ከመጀመሪያው ዙር የዩኤስ ኦፕን ውድድር ውጭ ሆኗል። የ39 ዓመቱ አትሌት በውድድሩ ወቅት በጠና ታሞ እንደነበር እና የጀርባ ህመም እና የጡንቻ መኮማተር እንዳጋጠመው ተናግሯል። ይህ ሽንፈት በሃያ ዓመታት ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ከመጀመሪያው ዙር እንዲሰናበት ያደረገው ሲሆን፣ ስለ ስፖርታዊ ህይወቱ ቀጣይነት ጥያቄዎችን ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Leenjisaa fi taphataan beekamaa Ispoortii Tennis Novak Djokovic morkii US Open irratti mo'atamee dorgommicha irraa gaggeeffameera. Umriin isaa 39 kan ta'e Djokovic taphicha keessatti dhukkuba, ciniinsuu fi dhukkubbiin dugdaa cimaan waan isa mudateef taphachuu dadhabeera. Injifannoon kun waggaa 20 keessatti yeroo jalqabaaf marsaa jalqabaatti akka inni ba'u kan taasise yoo ta'u, gara fuulduraatti taphachuu isaa irrattis shakkii uumeera.

title: Global coral reef coverage risks irreversible decline, new report warns
english: A recent report warns that global coral reefs are facing a potential irreversible decline because bleaching events are occurring too frequently for them to recover. These vital ecosystems, which support a quarter of all marine life, have suffered significantly since 2010 due to rising ocean temperatures. Experts now state that another widespread bleaching event is highly probable this year, threatening the health of the entire ocean.
amharic: አዲስ ሪፖርት እንደሚያሳየው፣ የባህር ውስጥ ኮራል ሪፎች በተደጋጋሚ በሚከሰት የነጭነት (bleaching) አደጋ ምክንያት ለዘላቂ ውድመት ተጋልጠዋል። እነዚህ ጠቃሚ ሥርዓተ-ምህዳሮች ከ2010 ወዲህ በውቅያኖስ የሙቀት መጠን መጨመር ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ባለሙያዎች እንደገለጹት፣ ዘንድሮም ሌላ ተመሳሳይ የኮራል ነጭነት ክስተት ሊከሰት ስለሚችል፣ የባህር ውስጥ ህይወትን በአጠቃላይ ለአደጋ እየዳረገ ይገኛል።
oromo: gabaasni haaraan akka ibsutti, koraalonni galaanaa (coral reefs) yeroo baay'ee walitti aansanii raawwii 'bleaching' jedhamuun miidhamaa waan jiraniif baduu malu. Sirnoota naannoo murteessoo ta'an kanneen, bara 2010 irraa eegalee hoo'i galaanaa dabaluun isaanii miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, bara kana keessaas lammata balaan akkanaa uumamuu danda'a, kunis jireenya galaanaa hundaaf sodaa guddaa ta'eera.

title: People return to their flood-ravaged homes in Nepal
english: Residents of Nepal's Nuwakot district are returning to their communities to search for belongings buried in mud following devastating flash floods. The disaster, triggered by a glacier collapse, has resulted in at least 781 deaths. Search operations continue as over 2,500 people remain missing in the affected mountain valleys.
amharic: በኔፓል ኑዋኮት አውራጃ የተከሰተውን ድንገተኛ ጎርፍ ተከትሎ ነዋሪዎች በጭቃና በደለል የተቀበሩ ንብረቶቻቸውን ለመፈለግ ወደ ቀያቸው እየተመለሱ ነው። የበረዶ ግግር መደርመስ ባስከተለው በዚህ አደጋ ቢያንስ 781 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ከ2,500 በላይ ሰዎች የት እንዳሉ ስለማይታወቅ የፍለጋ ስራው አሁንም ተጠናክሮ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Naannoo Nuwakot kan Neephaalitti, guuree tasaa booda namoonni qabeenya isaanii garagalchuuf gara manatti deebi'aa jiru. Balaan kun kan uumame kufuun cabbiin guddaa yeroo ta'u, lubbuun namoota 781 ta'uu mirkanaa'eera. Namoonni 2,500 ol ta'an ammoo dhabamanii waan jiraniif, hojiin barbaacha ammas itti fufee jira.

title: Iran denies attack on Kharg Island after Trump AI post showing its destruction
english: The head of Iran's national oil company has dismissed a social media video posted by Donald Trump that depicted the destruction of the Kharg Island oil terminal. Iranian officials stated that operations at the facility remain steady and normal despite the AI-generated imagery. They further emphasized that the site continues to function and undergo upgrades, even amid past threats from foreign adversaries.
amharic: የኢራን ብሔራዊ የነዳጅ ኩባንያ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በካርግ ደሴት ላይ የሚገኘው የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ መውደሙን የሚያሳይ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ የተለቀቀውን ቪዲዮ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) የተሰራው ምስል እውነት እንዳልሆነ እና ደሴቲቱ በተለመደው ሁኔታ ስራዋን እንደቀጠለች ገልጸዋል። በውጭ አካላት የሚደርሱ ዛቻዎች ቢኖሩም የነዳጅ ማጣሪያው ስራ ሳይቋረጥ እንደሚቀጥል እና ተቋሙን የማሻሻል ስራዎች እየተከናወኑ እንደሆነ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan dhaabbata boba'aa biyyoolessa Iraan, Donald Tiraamp viidiyoo 'AI' fayyadamee buufata boba'aa jireerra jiru, Kaarg Aayland, barbadaa'e jedhee gadi dhiise dhugaa akka hin taane ibseera. Qondaalonni Iraan akka jedhanitti, buufatichi tasgabbaa'aa fi iddoo haalaan hojjechaa jiruudha. Mootummaan Iraan, qormaatota gara garaa keessattuu, hojiin buufatichaa osoo hin dhaabbatin itti fufuusaa fi fooyya'iinsi buufatichaa irratti taasifamaa akka jiru mirkaneessaniiru.

title: US army officials warn Hegseth over continuing war on Iran: Report
english: Top U.S. military leaders have cautioned Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth against maintaining extensive military operations directed at Iran. This concern follows a classified review of current global troop deployments. While senior officials have formally expressed their opposition to these orders, they have confirmed they will still follow through with the directives.
amharic: ከፍተኛ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ መሪዎች የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩን ፒት ሄግሴትን በኢራን ላይ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ሰፊ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ እንዲቀንሱ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህ ማስጠንቀቂያ የወጣው አሁን ስላሉት ዓለም አቀፍ የወታደር ስምሪቶች ከተገመገመ ሚስጥራዊ ሪፖርት በኋላ ነው። ከፍተኛ የጦር መኮንኖች በወሰኑት ላይ ያላቸውን ተቃውሞ በይፋ ቢገልጹም ትእዛዙን ግን እንደሚፈጽሙ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni olaanoo waraana Ameerikaa ministira ittisa biyyaa Piit Hegseet irratti dhiibbaa uumaa jiru; kunis waraana Iran irratti gaggeessaa jiran akka dhaaban akeekkachiisaniiru. Akeekkachiisni kun kan dhufe gabaasa icitii raayyaa ittisa biyyaa addunyaa irra jiru erga ilaallatanii boodadha. Ajajoonni waraanaa mormii isaanii ibsataniyyu, ajajicha akka raawwatan mirkaneessaniiru.

title: UAE denies reports of Al-Minhad Air Base being targeted with missiles
english: The United Arab Emirates Ministry of Defense has officially rejected recent claims that Al-Minhad Air Base was hit by missile strikes. Authorities labeled these reports as completely false and baseless. They have requested that the public ignore rumors and rely strictly on information released by official government channels.
amharic: የተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬቶች የመከላከያ ሚኒስቴር የአል-ሚንሃድ አየር ማረፊያ በሮኬት ጥቃት ደርሶበታል በሚል በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ የተሰራጨውን መረጃ ውድቅ አድርጓል። ሚኒስቴሩ መረጃው ምንም አይነት መሰረት የሌለው ሀሰተኛ ወሬ መሆኑን አስታውቋል። ህብረተሰቡም ከሀሰተኛ መረጃዎች በመቆጠብ መረጃዎችን ከኦፊሴላዊ ምንጮች ብቻ እንዲከታተል አሳስቧል።
oromo: Ministeerri ittisa biyyaa Emireetota Arabaa Gamtoomanii gabaasa buufata xiyyaaraa Al-Minhaad irratti miiltoo rokkeetiin haleellaan raawwatame jedhu soba jechuun haaleera. Odeeffannoon kun dhugaa kan hin qabne fi kan dhugaa irraa fagaatedha jedhameera. Uummanni oduu sobaa irraa akka of qusatuu fi odeeffannoo dhugaa maddoota mootummaa irraa qofa akka argatu dhaamameera.

title: UAE says it dealt with drone approaching from Iran
english: The United Arab Emirates military successfully intercepted an unidentified drone that entered its territorial waters from the direction of Iran. The UAE Ministry of Defence confirmed the incident through an official statement on social media. Authorities stated that their air force took immediate action to address the threat and maintain national security.
amharic: የተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬትስ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ከኢራን አቅጣጫ ወደ አገሪቱ የባህር ክልል የገባ ሰው አልባ አውሮፕላን (ድሮን) መጥለፉን አስታውቋል። በይፋዊ መግለጫቸው እንዳመለከቱት፣ የአገሪቱ የአየር ኃይል ድሮኑን በመለየት አስፈላጊውን እርምጃ ወስዷል። የመከላከያ ሰራዊቱ የአገሪቱን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ ዝግጁ መሆኑንም አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Emireetota Araba Gamtoomanii, xiyyarri nama malee balali'u (drone) kallattii Iraan irraa gara daangaa bishanii biyyattii seenuudhaan dhufe akka hordofame ibseera. Ministeerri ittisa biyyattii akka ibsetti, waraanni qilleensa irraa xiyyaricha erga adda baasee booda tarkaanfii fudhateera. Humnoonni waraanaa eegumsa daangaa biyyattii mirkaneessuuf qophii ta'uu isaanii ibsi kun dabalatee ibseera.

title: Iran slams new US attacks, says its troops responded with 'inherent right of legitimate defence'
english: Iran has officially protested recent American military strikes on Larak Island. Claiming a right to self-defense, Iranian forces launched retaliatory attacks against U.S. facilities located in Jordan and the UAE. These actions were reportedly taken in response to a previous American strike that resulted in casualties among Iranian personnel and civilians.
amharic: ኢራን በላራክ ደሴት ላይ በተፈጸመው የአሜሪካ ጥቃት ላይ ጠንካራ ተቃውሞ አሰምታለች። የኢራን ጦር ራሱን የመከላከል መብቱን በመጠቀም በዮርዳኖስ እና በተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬቶች በሚገኙ የአሜሪካ መሰረተ ልማቶች ላይ የአጸፋ ጥቃት ሰንዝሯል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ቀደም ሲል በአሜሪካ በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ለደረሰው የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት ምላሽ ለመስጠት ነው።
oromo: Iraan weerara Ameerikaan ganda Larak irratti raawwatte cimsitee balaaleffatteetti. Waraanni Iraan mirga of ittisuu fayyadamuun, bu'uuraalee misoomaa Ameerikaa kanneen Yordaanosii fi Emireetota Arabaa keessa jiran irratti tarkaanfii deebii fudhateera. Tarkaanfiin kunis, weerara Ameerikaan duraan raawwattee fi du'a loltootaa fi nagoomotaa geessise hordofee kan fudhatameedha.

title: What are the implications of the US-Venezuela oil deal?
english: The United States and Venezuela have reached a new oil agreement that allows American companies to access a significant portion of Venezuela's petroleum reserves. While some leaders argue this partnership is essential for the nation's economic recovery, it has sparked considerable internal opposition. Experts are also currently debating the legal legitimacy of this energy deal.
amharic: አሜሪካ እና ቬንዙዌላ የአሜሪካ ኩባንያዎች የቬንዙዌላን የነዳጅ ሀብት በከፊል እንዲያለሙ የሚያስችል አዲስ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። የአገሪቱ መሪዎች ይህ ስምምነት ለኢኮኖሚ ማገገም ወሳኝ መሆኑን ቢናገሩም፣ በውስጥ በኩል ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። ባለሙያዎችም ስምምነቱ ህጋዊነት ላይ ክርክር እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ameerikaan fi Venezuweelan walii galtee boba'aa haaraa mallatteessanii jiru; kunis kampanionni Ameerikaa qabeenya boba'aa Venezuweelaa irraa harka guddaa akka fayyadaman carraa kenna. Hoggantoonni biyyattii walii galtichii diinagdee isaanii deebisanii ijaaruuf barbaachisaa dha jedhanii kan amanan ta'us, biyyattii keessatti mormiin cimaan ka'ee jira. Akkasumas, ogeeyyonni waa'ee seera qabeessummaa walii galtichaa irratti falmii gaggeessaa jiru.

title: Dozens evacuated and about 15 missing after Grand Canyon flash flood
english: A major flash flood in the Grand Canyon has forced the evacuation of over 60 people and left approximately 15 individuals unaccounted for. The severe weather destroyed bridges and altered the landscape, leading to the closure of several popular hiking trails and rafting routes. Authorities are currently searching for the missing persons and monitoring the area as further storms are expected.
amharic: በግራንድ ካንየን በተከሰተ ከፍተኛ ድንገተኛ ጎርፍ ከ60 በላይ ሰዎች ለቀቁ ሲሆን ወደ 15 የሚጠጉ ሰዎች የት እንዳሉ አልታወቀም። ጎርፉ የእግረኛ ድልድዮችን በማፍረስ አካባቢውን በመቀየሩ ታዋቂ የቱሪስት መንገዶች እና የጀልባ ጉዞዎች እንዲዘጉ ተደርጓል። ባለስልጣናት የጠፉ ሰዎችን የመፈለግ ስራ እየሰሩ ሲሆን ተጨማሪ ዝናብ እንደሚኖር በመጠበቅ ጥንቃቄ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Godina Giraandi Kaanyonitti balaa lolaa tasaa kanaan wal qabatee namoonni 60 ol ta'an iddoo jireenyaa irraa kan buqqa'an yoo ta'u, namoonni 15 ta'an ammoo bakka bu'aan isaanii hin beekamu. Loli kun darbiinsa lafoo barbadeessuun daandiiwwan bashannanaa fi imala markabootaa hedduu akka cufaman godheera. Abbootiin taayitaa namoota dhabaman barbaaduu fi jijjiirama qilleensaa hordofuun tarkaanfii fudhachaa jiru.

title: Flash flooding in Grand Canyon leaves more than 20 people missing
english: Authorities are searching for over 20 individuals following severe flash flooding in Arizona’s Grand Canyon caused by heavy rainfall. While rescue teams successfully evacuated more than 60 people by air, concerns remain for those currently unaccounted for. The surge of water was triggered by intense storms moving across the rocky landscape.
amharic: በአሪዞና ግራንድ ካንየን በደረሰ ከባድ የጎርፍ አደጋ ከ20 በላይ ሰዎች የገቡበት ባለመታወቁ የፍለጋ ስራ እየተከናወነ ይገኛል። የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች ከ60 በላይ ሰዎችን በአየር አውሮፕላን ማዳን የቻሉ ሲሆን፣ አሁንም በጎርፉ የተወሰዱ ሰዎችን ፍለጋ ቀጥሏል። ከባድ ዝናብ ባስከተለው ድንገተኛ ጎርፍ ምክንያት የአካባቢው መልክዓ ምድር ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶበታል።
oromo: Godina Arizona keessatti rooba cimaa robeen hordofee lolaa tasaa mudateen namoonni 20 ol ta'an baduu isaanii hordofee sakatta'iinsi gaggeeffamaa jira. Gareen fayyisuu namoota 60 ol ta'an xiyyaaraan bakka nageenyaa geessuun kan danda'ame yoo ta'u, namoota hin argamin barbaaduun itti fufeera. Balaan kun kan uumame rooba cimaa bu'een lolaan dachii qarsaa ta'e sana keessa yaa'uun isaatiin dha.

title: Iran war live: IRGC attacks US bases in Jordan after US bombs Larak Island
english: Tensions between Iran and the United States have escalated following a reciprocal exchange of military strikes. The US military bombed two Iranian rocket launchers on Larak Island, resulting in casualties among both fighters and civilians. In retaliation, Iran’s Revolutionary Guard Corps launched an attack against American military bases located in Jordan.
amharic: በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያለው ውጥረት ተባብሷል። የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች በኢራን ላራክ ደሴት ላይ በሚገኙ ሁለት የሮኬት ማስወንጨፊያዎች ላይ ባደረሱት ጥቃት የኢራን ተዋጊዎችና ሰላማዊ ሰዎች መጎዳታቸው ተገልጿል። ለዚህ አጸፋዊ ምላሽ የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘብ በዮርዳኖስ በሚገኙ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያዎች ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝሯል።
oromo: Walitti buutiin mootummoota Iraanii fi Amerikaa gidduu jiru hammaachaa dhufeera. Waraanni Amerikaa xiyyaara Iraan ka’umsa isaa Larak Island godhate irratti rukutta raawwateen namoonni hedduun ajjeefamuu fi madaa’uu isaanii gabaasameera. Iraanis kana hordofee buufataalee waraana Amerikaa kanneen Yordaanos keessatti argaman irratti haleellaa raawwateera.

title: What is Notting Hill Carnival’s Jab Jab parade?
english: The Jab Jab parade is a traditional dawn celebration that marks the opening of London's Notting Hill Carnival. Participants commemorate their Grenadian heritage by wearing devil horns and coating their bodies in motor oil. This annual event serves as a significant cultural expression for those dedicated to preserving their traditions.
amharic: የጃብ ጃብ ሰልፍ የለንደን የኖቲንግ ሂል ካርኒቫል መክፈቻን የሚያከብር ባህላዊ የማለዳ ዝግጅት ነው። ተሳታፊዎች የሰይጣን ቀንድ በማድረግ እና ሰውነታቸውን በሞተር ዘይት በመቀባት የግራናዳ ባህላቸውን ይገልጻሉ። ይህ ዓመታዊ በዓል ባህላቸውን ለመጠበቅ ለሚጥሩ ሰዎች ትልቅ ባህላዊ ፋይዳ አለው።
oromo: Hiriirri Jab Jab jedhamu sirna ganamaa kan jalqaba ayyaana Notting Hill Carnival kan Landan irratti raawwatamuudha. Hirmaattonni aadaa isaanii kan Girenadeedaatiin gophollee seexanaa godhatanii fi qaama isaanii zayitii konkolaataa dibachuun kabaju. Ayyaanichi waggaa waggaan kan kabajamu yoo ta'u, aadaa isaanii kunuunsuuf hirmaattotaaf bakka guddaa qaba.

title: US strikes Iranian launchers on Larak Island in first known attack in weeks
english: The United States military conducted a drone strike against two Iranian rocket launchers on Larak Island, marking the first such attack in several weeks. US officials stated the action was taken after observing Iranian forces preparing to deploy sea mines within the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz. Iran reported casualties from the strike and has publicly threatened to retaliate against the United States for this operation.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች በላራክ ደሴት ላይ በሚገኙ ሁለት የኢራን የሮኬት ማስወንጨፊያዎች ላይ ድሮን በመጠቀም ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው የኢራን ኃይሎች በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ ውስጥ የባህር ማዕድን ለመትከል ዝግጅት እያደረጉ እንደሆነ ከተስተዋለ በኋላ ነው። ኢራን በጥቃቱ የሰው ህይወት መጥፋቱን በመግለጽ በአሜሪካ ላይ በቀል እንደምትወስድ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Waraanni Ameerikaa daayree fayyadamuun maddeen rookeetii lama kan Iran, odola Laarak irra jiran irratti haleellaa raawwate. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame humnoonni Iran dhiyeenya galaana Hormuz keessatti miiniiwwan galaanaatti fayyadamuuf qophii gochuusaanii erga arganii boodadha. Iran miidhaa qaqqabeen walqabatee namoonni miidhamuu fi du'uu ibsuun, Ameerikaa irratti tarkaanfii deebii akka fudhattu doorsisteetti.

title: Hikers feared missing after 'terrifying' flash flooding hits Grand Canyon
english: Over 20 people are feared missing following a sudden, intense flash flood at the Grand Canyon that destroyed trails and bridges. Park rangers have already successfully airlifted 62 individuals to safety, and no injuries have been reported so far. Authorities have closed the affected areas as they continue rescue efforts and brace for more dangerous weather.
amharic: በግራንድ ካንየን በተከሰተው ድንገተኛ ጎርፍ ምክንያት ከ20 በላይ ሰዎች የገቡበት ሳይታወቅ ቀርቷል፣ ጎርፉም የብዙ የእግር መንገድና ድልድዮችን አውድሟል። የፓርኩ ጠባቂዎች እስካሁን 62 ሰዎችን በአየር አውሮፕላን ማዳን የቻሉ ሲሆን እስካሁን በሰው ህይወት ላይ የደረሰ ጉዳት የለም። ባለስልጣናት አካባቢውን የዘጉ ሲሆን፣ ተጨማሪ ዝናብና የጎርፍ አደጋ ሊከሰት እንደሚችል በመጠባበቅ ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Godina Garaa Kaanyon (Grand Canyon) keessatti lolaa tasaa mudateen namoonni 20 ol eessa akka jiran waan hin beekamneef yaaddoon guddaan jira; lolaanis karaalee fi daandiiwwan miidhameera. Ogeeyyoonni nageenyaa namoota 62 ta'an xiyyaaraan bakka nagaatti baasaniiru, hanga ammaattis namni miidhame hin jiru. Aangoonni mootummaa naannoo sana cufanii jiru akkasumas roobni fi lolaan itti fufuu waan danda'uuf of eeggannoo cimaa godhachaa jiru.

title: Vote count starts in Guinea-Bissau referendum on strengthening presidency
english: Guinea-Bissau has begun counting votes following a constitutional referendum aimed at shifting the country from a parliamentary to a presidential system. The current military-led government introduced this change to stabilize politics by granting the president greater authority to appoint ministers and dissolve parliament. Following a successful turnout, officials plan to hold national elections in December to return the country to civilian rule.
amharic: ጊኒ ቢሳው ሀገሪቱን ከፓርላማ ስርአት ወደ ፕሬዝዳንታዊ ስርአት ለመቀየር ያለመ ህገ-መንግስታዊ ህዝበ ውሳኔ ድምጽ መቁጠር ጀምሯል። አሁን ስልጣን ላይ ያለው ወታደራዊ መንግስት ይህንን ለውጥ ያስተዋወቀው ፕሬዝዳንቱ ሚኒስትሮችን የመሾም እና ፓርላማውን የመበተን ተጨማሪ ስልጣን በመስጠት የፖለቲካ መረጋጋትን ለመፍጠር ነው። ህዝበ ውሳኔው በተሳካ ሁኔታ መጠናቀቁን ተከትሎ፣ ሀገሪቱ በታህሳስ ወር ምርጫ በማካሄድ ወደ ሲቪል አስተዳደር ለመመለስ አቅዳለች።
oromo: Gini-Bisaaw biyyattii sirna paarlaamaarraa gara sirna pirezidaantiitti jijjiiruuf yaadamee, bu'aa sagalee yaada ummataa lakkaa'uu jalqabdeetti. Mootummaan yeroo ammaa humna waraatiin hoogganamu, pirezidaantichaaf aangoowwan gurguddoo kan akka muudama ministirootaa fi diigga paarlaamaa kennuun tasgabbii biyyattii mirkaneessuu barbaada. Sagaleen yaada ummataa kun karaa nagaan erga xumuramee booda, biyyattiin ji'a Muddeetti filannoo gaggeessuun gara bulchiinsa siviliitti deebi'uuf qophiirra jirti.

title: Lamine Yamal getting back to ‘top level’, Barcelona coach Flick says
english: Barcelona manager Hansi Flick expects teenage star Lamine Yamal to return to his best form following a difficult period caused by a recent hamstring injury and a demanding World Cup schedule. Although Yamal struggled during his first appearance of the season, Flick noted that the player showed significant improvement during his full 90-minute performance against Athletic Bilbao. The coach expressed confidence in Yamal's progress and emphasized the club's commitment to supporting the young talent as he works his way back to peak performance.
amharic: የባርሴሎናው አሰልጣኝ ሀንሲ ፍሊክ፣ ወጣቱ ኮከብ ላሚን ያማል በጉዳት እና በዓለም ዋንጫ ተሳትፎ ምክንያት ከነበረው የአቋም መውረድ ተላቆ ወደ ጥሩ ብቃቱ እየተመለሰ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ያማል የውድድሩን መጀመሪያ በችግር ቢያሳልፍም፣ አትሌቲክ ቢልባኦን በገጠሙበት ጨዋታ ሙሉ ለሙሉ በመጫወት ብቃቱን ማሻሻሉን አሰልጣኙ ጠቅሰዋል። ፍሊክ ተጫዋቹ ወደ ቀድሞ ከፍተኛ ብቃቱ እንዲመለስ ቡድኑ አስፈላጊውን ድጋፍ እንደሚያደርግለት ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Leenjisaan garee Barseloonaa Hansii Fliik akka ibsanitti, dargaggeessi biyya keenya Lamii Yaamaal miidhaa irra ga’ee tureefi qophii waancaa addunyaa booda gara gadi bu’iinsa sadarkaa isaatti deebi’uuf yaalaa jira. Yaamaal taphicha jalqaba irratti rakkoowwan mudataniyyuu, tapha Atleetik Bilbaoo irratti daqiiqaa 90 guutuu taphachuun isaa fooyya'iinsa guddaa akka qabu agarsiiseera. Leenjisaan kun akka jedhanitti, yaamaal gara sadarkaa isaa isa ol'aanaatti deebi'uuf qophiirra waan jiruuf, kilabichi deeggarsa barbaachisu hunda gochuuf murteesseera.

title: Israeli strike kills 3-year-old child in Gaza
english: An Israeli military strike in Deir el-Balah resulted in the deaths of two Palestinians, including a three-year-old child. This incident occurred during a period marked by ongoing daily attacks, despite the existence of a ceasefire agreement. Since the start of this ceasefire, the number of casualties has risen significantly, with over 1,300 Palestinians killed.
amharic: በዲር አል-ባላህ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል ጥቃት የሶስት አመት ህጻንን ጨምሮ ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ቢኖርም እንኳ በየቀኑ በሚካሄዱ ጥቃቶች መሃል ነው። የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱ ከተጀመረ ወዲህ ከ1,300 በላይ ፍልስጤማውያን መገደላቸው ተነግሯል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el magaala Deer al-Balaah irratti haleellaa raawwateen daa'ima waggaa sadii dabalatee namoonni lama ajjeefamaniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame walii galtee dhaabbii waraanaa jiru keessattuu haleellaan guyyaa guyyaan itti fufaa jiraachuun kanneen ibsameedha. Walii galteen kun erga jalqabee as namoonni Palastinii 1,300 ol ta'an ajjeefamuu gabaafameera.

title: Iran is attacking US forces in Jordan, Fox News reports, citing US source
english: According to reports from Fox News, Iranian forces have launched a missile attack on American troops stationed in Jordan. Officials noted that the strike has caused no major damage, as most of the projectiles were successfully blocked. The situation is being monitored as authorities assess the impact of the incident.
amharic: ፎክስ ኒውስ እንደዘገበው ኢራን በዮርዳኖስ በሚገኙ የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች ላይ የሚሳኤል ጥቃት ከፍታለች። አብዛኛዎቹ ሚሳኤሎች በመከላከያ ስርዓት የተመቱ በመሆናቸው በግለሰቦችና በንብረት ላይ የደረሰ ትልቅ ጉዳት እንደሌለ ተገልጿል። የጉዳዩን ሁኔታ አስመልክቶ ተጨማሪ ማጣሪያዎች እየተደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: gabaasa Fooks Niwus (Fox News) akka ibsetti, waraanni Iraan buufata waraana Ameerikaa kan Joordaan keessatti argamu irratti miisa'eeliiin haleellaa raawwateera. Miisa'eelonni hedduun isaanii sirna ittisaa kanaan gufachiifamuu isaanii hordofee, miidhaan guddaan akka hin geenye ibsameera. Haalli kun ammaaf to'annoo jala jira.

title: Iranian lawmaker warns US: ‘Retaliation is coming, just run’
english: A senior Iranian lawmaker has issued a stern warning to the United States following strikes on Iranian military launchers located on Larak Island. Ebrahim Azizi declared that Iran plans to retaliate with a severe and impactful response. He challenged the U.S. to reconsider its actions, suggesting that any further aggression will result in heavy consequences.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣን በላራክ ደሴት ላይ በሚገኙ የኢራን ሚሳይል ማስወንጨፊያዎች ላይ አሜሪካ ጥቃት መፈጸሟን ተከትሎ ጠንካራ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥተዋል። ኢብራሂም አዚዚ ኢራን ለዚህ ድርጊት አጸፋዊ እርምጃ እንደምትወስድ ገልጸው፣ ምላሻቸው ከባድ እና አሳማሚ እንደሚሆን አስታውቀዋል። አሜሪካ በድጋሚ ተመሳሳይ ጥቃት ብትፈጽም ከባድ ዋጋ እንደምትከፍልም ባለስልጣኑ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mana maree biyyattii Iraan, Ameerikaan lafa Larak jedhamutti buufata waraanaa Iraan irratti haleellaa raawwatteef gadoo akka baatan akeekkachiisaniiru. Ebrahim Azizi akka jedhanitti, Iraan tarkaanfii fudhatame kanaaf deebii cimaa fi miidhaa geessisu kennuuf qophiidha. Ameerikaan tarkaanfii kana irra deebi'uu akka hin qabne, akkasumas gochi biroo kamiyyuu gatii guddaa akka gaafatu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Lebanon says it welcomes Iran's interest in rebuilding bilateral ties
english: The Lebanese Foreign Ministry has expressed its support for improving diplomatic relations with Iran following positive signals from Iranian officials. This development follows a recent meeting in Tehran between Iran's Foreign Minister and a high-ranking Lebanese religious official. Lebanon emphasized its ongoing commitment to maintaining positive partnerships with all nations, including Iran.
amharic: የሊባኖስ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ከኢራን ባለስልጣናት በተሰጡ አዎንታዊ ምልክቶች መሰረት ከኢራን ጋር ያለውን የሁለትዮሽ ግንኙነት ለማጠናከር ያለውን ፍላጎት ገልጿል። ይህ መግለጫ የተሰጠው የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር እና የሊባኖስ ከፍተኛ የሃይማኖት መሪ በቅርቡ በቴህራን ከተገናኙ በኋላ ነው። ሊባኖስ ከኢራንን ጨምሮ ከሁሉም ሀገራት ጋር መልካም ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ለመፍጠር ቁርጠኛ መሆኗን አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Ministeerri Dhimmi Alaa Libanoon, hoggantoonni Iraan hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii cimsuuf fedhii qabaachuu isaanii erga ibsanii booda, akkaataa itti hariiroo sana fooyyeessan irratti deggarsa akka qabu beeksiseera. Haalli kun kan hordofe erga Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Iraanii fi hoggantoonni amantii olaanoo Libanoon Tehraan keessatti wal arganii booda dha. Libanoon Iraaniin dabalatee biyyoota hundaa wajjin hariiroo gaarii uumuu fi itti fufsiisuuf murannoo qabaachuu ishee mirkaneessiteetti.

title: US must get troops out of Gulf, former counterterrorism chief says
english: Former US counterterrorism official Joseph Kent is calling for the immediate withdrawal of American forces from the Gulf region to prevent further escalation with Iran. Kent warned that if Iranian retaliation leads to the deaths of US service members, it could force the country into a full-scale conflict on terms set by Tehran. He further argued that the ongoing tensions were instigated by Israeli influence rather than a direct threat to US security.
amharic: የቀድሞው የአሜሪካ የፀረ-ሽብርተኝነት ዋና ዳይሬክተር ጆሴፍ ኬንት ከአረብ ባህረ ሰላጤ አካባቢ የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች በአስቸኳይ እንዲወጡ ጠይቀዋል። የኢራን የበቀል እርምጃ የአሜሪካ ወታደሮችን ለሞት ቢዳርግ አሜሪካ በኢራን ውሎች ወደ ሰፊ ጦርነት እንድትገባ እንደሚያደርጋት አስጠንቅቀዋል። ግጭቱ የተፈጠረው በእስራኤል ተፅዕኖ እንጂ በአሜሪካ ላይ በደረሰ ቀጥተኛ ስጋት አይደለም ሲሉም ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan duraanii giddugala farra shororkeessummaa Ameerikaa Joosef Kent, waraanni Ameerikaa naannoo Goolfii irraa dafanii akka bahan gaafataniiru. Kent akka jedhanitti, humni Iran miidhaa geessisuun waraana Ameerikaa ajjeese, Ameerikaan akka fedha Iranitti gara waraana guddaatti akka seentu ishee dirqisiisuu danda'a. Walitti bu'iinsi kun kan uumame dhiibbaa Israa'el irraa malee, Ameerikaarratti sodaan hatattamaa jiraatee miti jechuun ibsaniiru.

title: 'A giant leap forward': Nasa launches powerful new space telescope
english: NASA has successfully launched the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope from Florida to study dark energy and black holes. This powerful new tool features a field of view 100 times larger than previous telescopes, allowing it to search for thousands of planets beyond our solar system. The spacecraft is currently traveling to a position one million miles from Earth to begin its ambitious mission of uncovering cosmic mysteries.

Meeshaan kun amma lafa irraa maayilii miiliyoona tokko fagaatee gara iddoo itti ramadameetti imalaa jiruu fi iccitii hawaa ibsuuf hojii isaa jalqaba.

title: Jose Andres renews call for investigation into WCK Gaza staff killings
english: World Central Kitchen founder Jose Andres is demanding an independent probe into the deaths of seven aid workers killed by Israeli strikes in Gaza. Despite the humanitarian team following a pre-approved route in clearly marked vehicles, they were targeted during their mission in April 2024. Andres continues to push for accountability regarding the tragic loss of these personnel.
amharic: የወርልድ ሴንትራል ኪችን መስራች ሆሴ አንድሬስ እ.ኤ.አ. በኤፕሪል 2024 በጋዛ በእስራኤል ጥቃት ለተገደሉ ሰባት የሰብአዊ እርዳታ ሰራተኞች ገለልተኛ ምርመራ እንዲደረግ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። የእርዳታ ሰራተኞቹ በእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በጸደቀ መስመር እና ምልክት በተደረገባቸው ተሽከርካሪዎች ሲጓዙ ነበር ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመባቸው። አንድሬስ ለዚህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት ተጠያቂነት እንዲኖር ግፊታቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Hundeesituun dhaabbata World Central Kitchen, Jose Andres, ji'a Ebla bara 2024 gaaza keessatti haleellaa Israa'elii lubbuun darbe hojjettoota gargaarsaa torba irratti qorannoon walaba ta'e akka gaggeeffamu gaafatan. Hojjettoonni kun karaa mootummaan Israa'el hayyamettiifi konkolaataawwan mallattoo qabanin socho'aa utuu jiranii haleellichi irratti raawwatame. Andres du'a hojjettoota kanaaf itti gaafatamummaan akka jiraatu ammas gaafachaa jiru.

title: ‘Opening a new chapter’: Syria reopens embassy in Libya after talks
english: Syria and Libya have officially agreed to resume diplomatic relations by reopening the Syrian embassy in Tripoli and establishing a consulate in Benghazi after 14 years of closure. Officials from both nations met to reactivate a joint committee aimed at strengthening political, economic, and security cooperation. This development follows major political changes in both countries and seeks to resolve outstanding issues regarding trade, investment, and the status of citizens residing in each other's territory.
amharic: ሶሪያ እና ሊቢያ ለ14 ዓመታት ተዘግቶ የቆየውን የሶሪያ ኤምባሲ በሊቢያ ዋና ከተማ ትሪፖሊ እንደገና ለመክፈት እና በቤንጋዚ የቆንስላ ጽሕፈት ቤት ለማቋቋም ተስማምተዋል። የሁለቱ አገራት ከፍተኛ ባለሥልጣናት የፖለቲካ፣ የኢኮኖሚ እና የጸጥታ ትብብራቸውን ለማጠናከር የሚያስችል የጋራ ኮሚቴ ለማንቀሳቀስ ተወያይተዋል። ይህ ስምምነት በሁለቱም አገራት በተከሰቱት የፖለቲካ ለውጦች መካከል የተደረገ ሲሆን፣ የንግድ ግንኙነቶችን እና የዜጎችን ጉዳዮች ለመፍታት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Siriyaafi Liibiyaan waggaa 14 booda embaasii Sooriyaa magaalaa Tripoli keessatti argamu deebisanii banuufi magaalaa Benghazi keessatti ammoo konsilaata banuuf walii galaniiru. Itti gaafatamtoonni biyyoota lamaanii hariiroo siyaasaa, dinagdeefi nageenyaa cimsuuf komitii gamtaa hojii eegaluuf mari'ataniiru. Walii galteen kun jijjiirama siyaasaa biyyoota lamaan keessatti mudate hordofee kan dhufe yoo ta'u, dhimmoota daldalaafi haala jiraattotaa furuuf kan gargaaruudha.

title: Video: Raging floodwaters sweep away lorry in the Philippines
english: Heavy monsoon rains in the Philippines led to severe flooding in the town of Rodriguez. During the event, a powerful surge of water carried away a lorry that had been caught in the path of the flood. Fortunately, all individuals inside the truck were able to safely exit the vehicle before it was pushed into a nearby creek.

oromo: Bokkaa cimaa Filippins keessatti roobeen wal qabatee, magaalatti Roordriguez keessatti lolaan cimaan uumamee jira. title: US strikes Iran’s Larak Island in first attack in weeks
english: The United States conducted an airstrike on Larak Island in southern Iran, marking the first military engagement between the two nations in several weeks. The mission targeted rocket launchers meant to deploy mines near the Strait of Hormuz, causing several casualties among Iranian soldiers. In response, Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps condemned the action and promised to retaliate against the aggression.

oromo: Ameerikaan dirree qilleensaa kuta kibba Iraan, odola Laaraak jedhamutti haleellaa raawwachuun, walitti bu'iinsi biyyoota lamaanii torbanoota hedduu booda akka haaromfame ibsiteetti. Haleellaan kun meeshaalee gurguddoo Hormuz keessatti miineelee (mines) facaasuuf qophaa'an irratti xiyyeeffatee kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, loltoota Iraan irra miidhaa geessiseera. Humnoonni waraana Iraan haleellaa kana balaaleffachuun, biyyi isaanii haaloo ba'uuf akka qophooftu beeksisaniiru.

title: Butcher of Bosnia Ratko Mladic still hailed as a hero by some Serbs
english: A large group of Bosnian Serbs recently gathered to honor Ratko Mladic, the former military commander who was found guilty of genocide and various war crimes during the Bosnian conflict. Despite his legal conviction for orchestrating atrocities like the Srebrenica massacre, he continues to be viewed as a heroic figure by some segments of the population. This event highlights the ongoing division and controversy surrounding his legacy in the region.

oromo: gareen saba Boosniyaa Serbs ta'an baay'een, ajajaan waraanaa duraanii Raatkoo Mlaadiich kan ajjeechaa sanyii fi yakka waraana biroo irratti himatamanii murtiin irratti darbe kabajuuf walgahanii turan. Gocha suukanneessaa Srebrenitsa keessatti raawwatamee fi yakka waraanaatiin mana murtiitiin balaaleffatamanii illee, qaamonni tokko tokko amma iyyuu akka gootatti isa ilaalu. Walgahii kana irratti mul'achuu isaa, seenaan ajajaa kanaa naannichatti har'as akka wal-falmisiisaa fi hirribaa guddaa uume agarsiisa.

title: Seven wounded in al-Mughayyir as Israeli forces besiege the village
english: Seven Palestinians were injured, mostly by gunfire, during an Israeli military raid and settler activity in the West Bank village of al-Mughayyir. Following the violence, Israeli forces have blocked access to the village, effectively placing it under siege. This incident occurs as part of a recent surge in settler-led attacks and land seizure efforts across the occupied West Bank.
