oromo: Godina West Bank magaalaa Al-Mughayyir keessatti lolaa fi weerara humnoota Israa'el fi qonnaan bultoota (settlers) gaggeessaniin namoonni torba madaa'aniiru. Humni Israa'el erga haleellaa kana raawwatee booda karaa magaalattii cufuudhaan akkasumas marsuudhaan qubsiiseera. Gochi kun, weerara fi saamicha lafaa qonnaan bultoota Israa'el gama kanaan duraa irratti hammaataa dhufaa jiru keessatti kan dabalatudha.

title: Iran vows response to US attack, calls it ‘fatal mistake’
english: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps has condemned a recent US military strike on Larak island that resulted in multiple deaths and injuries among fighters and civilians. Iranian officials described the attack as a major error and promised to retaliate through both economic and military measures. Tensions have heightened as Iran vows to hold those responsible accountable for the incident.

Gochi kun walitti bu’iinsa biyyoota lamaanii hammaachisee jira.

title: US forces strike two Iranian launchers on Iran's Larak island
english: United States military forces carried out airstrikes against two Iranian rocket launchers on Larak Island after observing preparations to deploy naval mines into the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian authorities reported that the operation resulted in several casualties and have vowed to retaliate against the U.S. This incident follows previous warnings from President Trump that any attempts by Iran to mine these international waters would be met with military action.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች በላራክ ደሴት የሚገኙ ሁለት የኢራን የሮኬት ማስወንጨፊያዎችን በአየር ጥቃት አውድመዋል። ይህ የተደረገው የኢራን ኃይሎች በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ ውስጥ የባህር ማዕድኖችን ለመትከል ሲዘጋጁ በመታየታቸው ነው። ኢራን በጥቃቱ ሳቢያ ለደረሰው ጉዳት አጸፋዊ እርምጃ እንደምትወስድ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Ameerikaa rookeetiiwwan Iran irratti argaman lama kan Larak Island keessatti argaman haleelanii barbadeessaniiru. Gochi kun kan raawwatamee humnoonni Iran galaana Hormuz keessatti miinota galaana keessaa dhaabuuf qophii gochaa osoo jiranii argamuu isaaniitiin booda dha. Iran haleellaa kanaan namoonni miidhamuu isaa ibsuun, deebii cimaa akka kennitu waadaa galteetti.

title: British Arabs urge UK government to impose binding restrictions on Israeli settlements
english: A group of influential British-Arab leaders has urged the UK government to implement strict, legally binding measures to halt any economic involvement that supports illegal Israeli settlements. The signatories argue that current voluntary policies are insufficient and that the UK must use existing laws to block trade and investment that fuel settlement expansion. Additionally, they are calling for international cooperation to protect Palestinian civilians from settler violence.
amharic: የታዋቂ የብሪታንያ አረብ መሪዎች ቡድን የብሪታንያ መንግስት ህገ-ወጥ በሆኑ የእስራኤል ሰፈራዎች ላይ የሚደረገውን የኢኮኖሚ ድጋፍ የሚያስቆም ጥብቅ ህጋዊ እርምጃ እንዲወስድ ጠይቀዋል። አሁን ያሉት የበጎ ፈቃድ መመሪያዎች በቂ እንዳልሆኑ የገለጹት እነዚህ ወገኖች፣ መንግስት የንግድ እና የኢንቨስትመንት እንቅስቃሴዎችን ለመግታት አሁን ባለው ህግ ሊጠቀም ይገባል ብለዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ ፍልስጤማውያንን ከሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት ለመጠበቅ ከአለም አቀፍ አካላት ጋር በመተባበር እንዲሰሩ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Gareen hogganoota Biriiteen-Arabaa ta’an kanneen dhiibbaa uuman, mootummaan Biriiteen sochii dinagdee buufataalee Israa’eel seeraan alaa deeggaran hunda akka dhaabuuf gaafataniiru. Qajeelfamoonni ammayyaa fedhii irratti hundaa’an gahaa akka hin taane kan ibsan yoo ta’u, mootummaan daldalaafi invastimantii seeraan alaa kana dhaabuuf seera qabu akka fayyadamu gaafataniiru. Kana malees, lammiilee Falastiinii haleellaa qubattootaa irraa ittisuuf tumsa idil-addunyaa akka uuman gaafataniiru.

title: US visa sanctions expose the limits of diplomatic pragmatism
english: The U.S. government has imposed visa restrictions on certain TPLF members, a move criticized for prioritizing political convenience over addressing genocide. Critics argue that forcing Tigrayans to reconcile with those accused of attempting to destroy them without proper accountability undermines true justice. By focusing on these political figures rather than the broader reality of mass atrocities, the U.S. is accused of abandoning its core values and failing to pursue a lasting, honest peace.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት በህወሃት አባላት ላይ የቪዛ ማዕቀብ መጣሉ፣ ከፍትህ ይልቅ ፖለቲካዊ ጥቅምን ያስቀደመ ነው በሚል ትችት እየቀረበበት ነው። በዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል የተጠረጠሩ አካላት ጋር ያለ ፍትህ እና ተጠያቂነት የሰላም ስምምነት እንዲፈጠር መገፋፋቱ እውነተኛ ሰላምን እንደማያመጣ ተቺዎች ይናገራሉ። አሜሪካ በነዚህ እርምጃዎች የራሷን የሰብአዊ መብት እሴቶች እንደጣሰች እና ለዘላቂ ሰላም መሠረት መሆን ያለበትን የፍትህ ሂደት እንዳጓደለች ይነገራል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa miseensota TPLF tokko tokko irratti dhorkaa viizaa kaa'uun isaa, haqaa fi itti gaafatamummaa caalaa faayidaa siyaasaa irratti kan xiyyeeffate ta'uu isaa hordoftoonni ni qeeqan. Namoota sanyii mancaasuu keessatti hirmaatan jedhaman wajjin tokkummaa uumuuf dirqisiisuun haqaa dhugaa akka hin dhufne taasisa jedhamee falmameera. Ameerikaan tarkaanfii kanaan dhaabbata isheen qabduu fi dhimma namummaa tuffatteetti, akkasumas nagaa waaraa fiduuf karoorri ishee sirrii miti jedhamee qeeqamaa jira.

title: Seven killed and 23 missing in boat capsizing off northern Cyprus
english: A passenger ferry carrying over 260 people capsized off the coast of Northern Cyprus after being struck by powerful waves. Authorities have confirmed at least seven deaths, with dozens of others remaining missing despite ongoing rescue efforts by sea and air. The vessel’s captain and crew are currently in custody as officials investigate potential negligence regarding the incident.
amharic: በሰሜን ሳይፕረስ የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ ከ260 በላይ ሰዎችን የጫነ የባህር ጉዞ መርከብ በኃይለኛ ማዕበል ተመትቶ ሰምጧል። አደጋው የቢያንስ ሰባት ሰዎችን ህይወት የቀጠፈ ሲሆን፣ በርካታ ሰዎች አሁንም የሉም። የአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት የመርከቧን ካፒቴን እና ሰራተኞች በቁጥጥር ስር በማዋል በግድየለሽነት ላይ ምርመራ እየጀመሩ ሲሆን፣ የነፍስ አድን ስራውም አሁንም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Dooniin imaltoota 260 ol baatte tokko qarqara galaana Kaaba Qupiroositti weerara bishaanitiin erga rukutamtee booda gombifamteerti. Balaa kanaan lubbuun namoota torbaa darbuun mirkanaa'eera, namoonni hedduun ammoo ammallee bakka bu'aan isaanii hin beekamu. Hojiiwwan fayyisuu ammayyuu kan itti fufan yoo ta'u, qondaaltonni mootummaa balicha irratti qorannoo geggeessuuf jecha kabitaanii fi hojjettoota doonii sana to'annoo jala oolchaniiru.

title: Nepal’s flood survivors search for missing loved ones
english: Nepal is currently facing a dire humanitarian crisis following devastating floods that have claimed nearly 800 lives. Rescue teams are working tirelessly to find survivors, including those trapped under debris, while thousands of people remain unaccounted for. Families are enduring a heartbreaking search, scanning images of victims in hopes of locating their missing relatives.
amharic: በኔፓል በደረሰው ከባድ የጎርፍ አደጋ የ800 ሰዎች ሕይወት ሲያልፍ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ደግሞ የት እንደደረሱ አልታወቀም። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች በፈራረሱ ቤቶች ውስጥ ተጠልፈው የሚገኙ ሰዎችን ለማዳን ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ቤተሰቦችም የጠፉ ዘመዶቻቸውን ለማግኘት በከፍተኛ ጭንቀት ውስጥ ሆነው የተገኙ አስከሬኖችን ምስል በመመልከት ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Neepaali keessatti lolaa hamaa mudateen lubbuun namoota 800 ol kan darbe yoo ta'u, namoonni kuma sadii ol immoo bakka bu'an hin beekamu. Gareen gargaarsaa gamoo fi xurii jala kan qabaman oolchuuf dadhabbiin hojjechaa jiru. Maatiin namoota isaanii dhaban immoo fira isaanii barbaachaaf suuraa reeffa argame ilaaluun gaddaan guutamanii jiru.

title: NASA launches $4.3bn Roman Telescope to uncover universe’s hidden secrets
english: NASA has successfully launched the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, a $4.3 billion project designed to explore the mysteries of dark energy, dark matter, and planets outside our solar system. Carried by a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket, the observatory is traveling to a distant point in space where it will spend years mapping billions of galaxies. This mission aims to significantly improve our understanding of how the universe is structured and how rapidly it is expanding.
amharic: ናሳ የ4.3 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ወጪ የተደረገበትን የናንሲ ግሬስ ሮማን የጠፈር ቴሌስኮፕ በተሳካ ሁኔታ ወደ ጠፈር አስጀምሯል። ይህ ፕሮጀክት ስለ ጨለማ ጉልበት፣ ጨለማ ቁስ እና ከፀሐይ ስርአታችን ውጭ ያሉ ፕላኔቶችን ምስጢራት ለመመርመር ያለመ ነው። በስፔስ ኤክስ ሮኬት የተላከው ይህ ቴሌስኮፕ በቢሊዮኖች የሚቆጠሩ ጋላክሲዎችን በመቃኘት የአጽናፈ ሰማይን አፈጣጠር እና መስፋፋት በተመለከተ አዳዲስ እውቀቶችን ይሰጣል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: NASA'n teleskopii haaraa 'Nancy Grace Roman' jedhamu kan gatiin isaa biliyoona 4.3 ta'u injifannoon gara hawaatti ergeera. Teleskopichi iccitii 'dark energy', 'dark matter' fi pilaanetoota sirna biiftuu keenya alatti argaman qorachuuf gargaara. Rokketii SpaceX Falcon Heavy jedhamuun gara iddoo fagoo ergame kun, galaksiiwwan biliyoonaan lakkaa'aman qorachuun, bal'inaa fi caasaa addunyaa keenya hubachuuf gumaacha guddaa gochuu ni danda'a.

title: Trump threatens to report journalist Kristen Welker to broadcast regulator
english: President Donald Trump has announced plans to report NBC journalist Kristen Welker to the Federal Communications Commission. He claims her assessment of his election endorsements as having mixed results is inaccurate and misleading to the public. This action reflects his ongoing strategy of using federal regulatory oversight to challenge news organizations he views as biased.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የኤንቢሲዋን ጋዜጠኛ ክሪስቲን ዌልከርን ለፌዴራል ኮሙኒኬሽን ኮሚሽን (FCC) እንደሚከሷት አስታውቀዋል። ጋዜጠኛዋ የሱ የምርጫ ድጋፍ ውጤት የተቀላቀለ ነው በማለቷ፣ መረጃዋ የተሳሳተ እና ህዝብን የሚያሳስት ነው ሲሉ ይከራከራሉ። ይህ ድርጊት አድሎአዊ ናቸው ብለው የሚያስቧቸውን የሚዲያ ተቋማት ለመገዳደር የፌዴራል ቁጥጥር ተቋማትን የመጠቀም የትራምፕ ቀጣይ አካሄድ አካል ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaant Donald Traamp gaazexeessituu NBC Kristen Welker irratti komii gara Komishinii Kominikeeshinii Federaalaa (FCC) dhiyeessuuf karoora qaban beeksisaniiru. Ibsa gaazexeessituun kun deggeroota isaan filannoo irratti qaban ilaalchisee kennite dogoggoraa fi hawaasa wallaalchisuudha jedhaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun miidiyaaleen wal-lootuudha jedhanii amananii fi tarkaanfii fudhachuuf dhaabbata federaalaa fayyadamuu akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: Zambia opposition leader Brian Mundubile charged with treason
english: Zambian opposition politician Brian Mundubile and his associate Makebi Zulu have been formally accused of treason. Mundubile, who headed the NRPUP party and finished as the runner-up in the August 13 election, had previously attempted to contest the poll results. However, his legal efforts were unsuccessful after courts became inaccessible before the filing deadline.
amharic: የዛምቢያው የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲ መሪ ብራያን ሙንዱቢሌ እና ምክትላቸው ማኬቢ ዙሉ በአገር ክህደት ወንጀል ተከሰሱ። ኤንአርፒዩፒ የተሰኘውን ፓርቲ የሚመሩት ሙንዱቢሌ፣ ነሐሴ 13 በተካሄደው አወዛጋቢ ምርጫ ሁለተኛ ደረጃን ይዘው ነበር። የያዙትን የምርጫ ውጤት ለመቃወም የሞከሩ ቢሆንም፣ ፍርድ ቤቶች በተቀመጠው የጊዜ ገደብ ምክንያት ባለመክፈታቸው ሙከራቸው ሳይሳካ ቀርቷል።
oromo: Hogganaan mormituu Zambiyaa Biraayan Munduubiile fi gargaartonni isaa Makeebii Zuuluu yakka gantootummaan himatamaniiru. Munduubiile hogganaa paartii NRPUP ta'uun filannoo Hagayya 13 gaggeeffame keessatti bakka lammaffaa kan qabatan yoo ta'u, bu'aa filannichaa mormuuf yaalii godhaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, mana murtii sadarkaa isaanii dhiyaachuu kan dhaban ta'uun, carraaqqiin isaanii sun milkaa'uu hin dandeenye.

title: Israeli forces shoot two Palestinians during settler attacks near Ramallah
english: Two Palestinians were injured by live gunfire during a violent encounter involving Israeli settlers near the village of al-Mughayyir in the occupied West Bank. Local officials reported that Israeli forces facilitated the settler attacks by blocking access to the area for residents. Medical teams transported the wounded to nearby hospitals for emergency treatment following the confrontation.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አል-ሙጋዪር መንደር አቅራቢያ በተፈጠረ ግጭት ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን በእስራኤል ኃይሎች እና በሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት ቆስለዋል። የአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት እስራኤላውያን ወታደሮች ሰፈራቸውን ለማስጠበቅ የአካባቢውን መንገድ በመዝጋት ለጥቃቱ ምቹ ሁኔታን ፈጥረዋል። ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሰዎች በአስቸኳይ ወደ ሆስፒታል ተወስደው ህክምና እየተደረገላቸው ነው።
oromo: Naannoo Qilleensa Qabamee jiru kan West Bank, baadiyyaa al-Mughayyiritti, haleellaa qonnaan bultoota Israa'elii fi waraana Israa'el irra ga'een namoonni Falasxiin lama miidhamaniiru. Hogganoonni naannichaa akka ibsanitti, waraanni Israa'el karaa cufuudhaan haleellaa qonnaan bultootaaf akka mijatu gochuu isaanii beekameera. Namoonni miidhaan irra ga'e kunis gara mana yaalaatti geeffamanii yaalamaniiru.

title: Mecca pact's first trilateral meeting to be held in Istanbul on Monday
english: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan are holding their first trilateral meeting in Istanbul this Monday following the recent signing of a mutual defense agreement in Mecca. The high-level talks will include foreign ministers, defense officials, and military leaders from all three nations. This security pact establishes a collective defense framework, meaning that any aggression against one participating country will be considered an attack on all of them.
amharic: ቱርክ፣ ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ እና ፓኪስታን በቅርቡ በሜካ ከተፈራረሙት የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት በኋላ የመጀመሪያውን የሶስትዮሽ ስብሰባ ሰኞ በኢስታንቡል ሊያካሂዱ ነው። በስብሰባው ላይ የሶስቱ ሀገራት የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች፣ የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሮች እና ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ መሪዎች ይሳተፋሉ። ይህ ስምምነት በአንዱ ሀገር ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሶስቱም ሀገራት ላይ እንደተፈጸመ ጥቃት እንደሚቆጠር ይደነግጋል።
oromo: Turkiin, Sa'udii Arabiyaa fi Paakistaan waligaltee ittisa biyyaalessaa kan Ka'abaatti mallatteessan booda walgahii isaanii isa jalqabaa Dilbata kana Istanbulitti gaggeessuuf karoorfataniiru. Walgahii kana irratti ministiroonni alaa, ministiroonni ittisaa fi ajajoonni waraanaa biyyoota sadanii ni hirmaatu. Walgaliin kun biyyoota sadeen keessaa tokko irratti yoo haleellaan raawwatame, haleellaan sun akka waan sadeen irrattuu raawwatametti kan ilaalamu ta'uu mirkaneessa.

title: Tanker struck by projectile in Hormuz, UKMTO says
english: A commercial tanker was hit by an unidentified object while passing through the Strait of Hormuz near Oman on Saturday. British maritime authorities reported the incident but confirmed that there were no injuries or environmental damage. Officials are currently investigating the circumstances surrounding the attack.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ዕለት በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በኩል ሲያልፍ የነበረ የንግድ መርከብ በማይታወቅ ነገር ተመትቷል። የብሪታንያ የባህር ላይ ንግድ ኦፕሬሽን ኤጀንሲ እንደገለጸው በሰውም ሆነ በአካባቢ ላይ የደረሰ ጉዳት የለም። ባለስልጣናት በአሁኑ ወቅት ክስተቱን በማጣራት ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Sambata darbe markabni daldalaa tokko yommuu handhuura Hormuz ce'u miidhaan irra ga'eera. Abbootiin taayitaa bishaan keessa deemaa kan Biritish akka ibsanitti, miidhaa qaamaa ykn faalama naannoo tokkollee hin geenye. Ammaaf qaamoleen dhimmi ilaallatu qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: British activist abducted by armed Israeli settlers in Masafer Yatta
english: A British activist named Finn Joughin was forcibly detained by armed Israeli settlers in the West Bank village of Umm al-Khair before being transferred to police custody. While settlers claim the detention was related to sexual abuse allegations, legal representatives state he was held in a shed after shielding a child near a fence. The British government is currently in contact with Israeli officials to investigate the situation as the activist prepares for a court appearance.
amharic: ፊን ጆጊን የተባሉ ብሪታንያዊ አክቲቪስት በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ኡም አል-ካይር መንደር በታጠቁ እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች ተይዘው ለፖሊስ ተላልፈው ተሰጥተዋል። ሰፋሪዎቹ በወሲባዊ ጥቃት ክስ እንዳሰሩዋቸው ቢናገሩም፣ የህግ አማካሪዎቻቸው ግን አክቲቪስቱ ህፃን ልጅን ለመከላከል ሲሞክሩ በግዳጅ ታግተው እንደነበር ይናገራሉ። የብሪታንያ መንግስት የጉዳዩን ሂደት እየተከታተለ ሲሆን፣ አክቲቪስቱም በኢየሩሳሌም ፍርድ ቤት ቀርበው ክርክር ያደርጋሉ ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Goggeessaan lammii Biriitish Finn Joughin jedhamu, baadiyaa Umm al-Khair kan West Bank keessatti hidhattoota qe'ee qabachuu barbaadan isiraa'elootaan humnaan qabamee poolisiif dabarfame. Gaggeessitootni kun himannaa saalaan walqabate akka jiru ibsanus, abukaattoon isaa garuu inni ijoollee eeguuf yaaluun isaa gidiraa akka isatti ta'e ibsu. Mootummaan Biriitish haala kana hordofaa jiru yoo ta'u, inniis torban kana mana murtiitti dhiyaatee falmata jedhamee eegama.

title: Canada installs large Lake Ontario sign in latest jab at US
english: Ontario Premier Doug Ford has installed a sign asserting the name 'Lake Ontario' after President Trump issued an executive order to rename the body of water 'Lake America.' This move follows a breakdown in trade negotiations that led to new tariffs being imposed between the two countries. While Google Maps has updated its labels for US users to reflect the change, Canadian officials maintain that the name will remain the same.
amharic: የኦንታሪዮ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ዳግ ፎርድ፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የኦንታሪዮ ሐይቅን ስም ወደ 'አሜሪካ ሐይቅ' ለመቀየር ትዕዛዝ ካስተላለፉ በኋላ የሐይቁ ስም 'ኦንታሪዮ' መሆኑን የሚያረጋግጥ ታፔላ አስቀምጠዋል። ይህ ውዝግብ የተፈጠረው በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል የተደረገው የንግድ ድርድር በመቋረጡ እና አዲስ የታሪፍ ግብሮች በመጣላቸው ነው። ጎግል ማፕስ በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ለሚገኙ ተጠቃሚዎች ስሙን ቢቀይርም፣ የካናዳ ባለስልጣናት ግን የሐይቁ ስም ሳይቀየር እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministiraa Ontaariyoo Daag Foord, pirezidaanti Traamp haroo Ontaariyoo maqaa 'Haroo Ameerikaa' jedhuun jijjiiruuf ajaja dabarsanii booda, maqaan harichaa 'Ontaariyoo' akka ta'e ibsuuf mallattoo guddaa dhaabaniiru. Wal-dhabdeen kun kan uumame erga daldalli biyyoota lamaan gidduu ture diigamee fi gibriin haaraa erga irratti dabamee booda. Google Maps itti fayyadamtoota Yuunaayitid Isteetsiif maqicha jijjiirus, hoggantoonni Kaanaadaa maqaan harichaa akka hin jijjiiramne ibsaniiru.

title: How does your name taste? The strange science of synaesthesia
english: Synaesthesia is a unique neurological condition where one sensory experience, such as hearing a name, automatically triggers another sense, like taste or color. Many people with this condition do not realize their perception is unusual until they discover that others do not share these sensory overlaps. Experts suggest that up to four percent of the population may have synaesthesia, though many cases go undiagnosed because individuals often assume their experiences are universal.
amharic: ሲነስቲዢያ (Synaesthesia) አንድን የስሜት ህዋስ ሲነቃ ሌላኛው በራስ-ሰር የሚነቃበት ልዩ የነርቭ ሁኔታ ነው። ብዙ የዚህ ሁኔታ ተጠቂዎች ሰዎች ሁሉም ሰው እንደነሱ ስለሚሰማው፣ የራሳቸው ተሞክሮ የተለየ መሆኑን ሳያውቁ ይቆያሉ። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት እስከ አራት በመቶ የሚሆነው የዓለም ህዝብ ይህንን ሁኔታ ሊኖረው እንደሚችል እና ብዙ ሰዎች የራሳቸው ተሞክሮ ተፈጥሯዊ እንደሆነ ስለሚያስቡ ሳይመረመሩ እንደሚቀሩ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Siinaastiiziyaa (Synaesthesia) jechuun hubannoo sammuu kan namni tokko sagalee ykn waan tokko yeroo dhagahu ykn argu, miirri biraa kan akka dhandhamoo ykn bifa sammuu isaa keessatti uumamuudha. Namoonni hedduun dandeettii kana qaban, namni hundinuu akkasuma waan itti dhagahamuuf, waan haaraa ykn adda ta'e akka qaban hin beekan. Ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, harki afur ummata addunyaa kana qabaachuu danda'u, garuu namoonni hedduun haalli kun waan baramaa ta'eef osoo of hin qorachiisin hafu.

title: Iceland votes to reject EU accession talks: What happens next?
english: Icelandic voters have narrowly rejected a proposal to restart membership negotiations with the European Union. Although the referendum was technically non-binding, the government has committed to respecting the result, which reflects public concerns over national sovereignty and the protection of the fishing industry. This outcome halts the administration's efforts to seek closer economic and political ties with the bloc at this time.
amharic: የአይስላንድ መራጮች ከአውሮፓ ህብረት ጋር የአባልነት ድርድርን እንደገና ለመጀመር የቀረበውን ሀሳብ በትንሽ ልዩነት ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ምንም እንኳን ውጤቱ ህጋዊ አስገዳጅ ባይሆንም፣ መንግስት የህዝቡን ውሳኔ እንደሚያከብር አስታውቋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የሀገሪቱን የባህር ሀብት እና ሉዓላዊነት ለመጠበቅ ባላቸው ስጋት የተነሳ፣ መንግስት ከህብረቱ ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት ለማጠናከር የነበረውን ጥረት አግዶታል።
oromo: Ummanni Ayislandi marii miseensummaa Gamtaa Awurooppaa waliin deebisanii jalqabuuf dhiyaate sagalee caalmaan didaniiru. Bu'aan kun dirqisiisaa kan hin taane ta'us, mootummaan yaada uummataa kabajuuf murteesseera. Murtoon kun kan dhufe rakkoo qabeenya qurxummii fi bilisummaa biyyattii irratti yaaddoo qaban irraa ka'uudhaan, mootummaan gamtichatti makachuuf carraaqqii taasisaa ture akka dhaabatu taasiseera.

title: Banque Misr, Egypt’s second-largest, hit by US sanctions: What to know
english: The United States is cutting off the UAE branches of Egypt’s Banque Misr from the American financial system due to allegations that the bank facilitated transactions for the Iranian government. This action is part of a broader US campaign to restrict Iran’s access to global funds and US dollars. While the bank is currently reviewing the Treasury's notice, the proposed rule would prevent its UAE operations from conducting dollar-based transactions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት የግብጹ ባንክ 'ባንክ ሚስር' የተባለ ተቋም ከኢራን መንግስት ጋር የገንዘብ ልውውጥ አድርጓል በሚል በባንኩ የተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬት ቅርንጫፎች ላይ ማዕቀብ ጥሏል። ይህ እርምጃ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የምታደርገውን የኢኮኖሚ ጫና አካል ሲሆን ባንኩ የአሜሪካን ዶላር እና የገንዘብ ስርዓት እንዳይጠቀም ይከለክላል። የግብጹ ባንክ የዩኤስ ግምጃ ቤት የሰጠውን ማሳሰቢያ እያጠና መሆኑን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa baankii Gibxii kan ta'e 'Banque Misr' qaama mootummaa Iraan waliin walitti dhufeenya maallaqaa qabaachuun himatee, dameewwan baankichaa kan UAE irratti tarkaanfii fudhateera. Tarkaanfiin kun dhiibbaa diinagdee Ameerikaan Iraan irratti gootu keessaa isa tokko yoo ta'u, baankichi sirna maallaqa Ameerikaa fi doolaara fayyadamuu akka hin dandeenye dhorka. Baankichi hubachiisa Ministeera Maallaqa Ameerikaa irraa dhufe qorachaa akka jiru beeksiseera.

title: Van Dijk wants Cody Gakpo to stay at Liverpool despite Man City interest
english: Liverpool captain Virgil van Dijk has publicly expressed his desire for teammate Cody Gakpo to remain at the club amid strong transfer interest from Manchester City. While the team is preparing for the arrival of new signing Bradley Barcola, Van Dijk emphasized Gakpo's importance to the squad and their personal friendship. Liverpool is currently considering a significant offer for the Dutch forward as they navigate a period of tactical transition under manager Andoni Iraola.

title: Dozens of soldiers arrested after apparent coup attempt in Niger’s capital
english: Military authorities in Niger have detained dozens of soldiers following a failed attempt to overthrow the current government in Niamey. The incident occurred after a period of instability and represents a significant challenge to the nation's ruling junta. State television confirmed the arrests, signaling that the authorities have regained control of the situation.
amharic: በኒጀር ዋና ከተማ ኒያሜይ መንግስትን ለመገልበጥ ሙከራ ያደረጉ በርካታ ወታደሮች በቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል። ይህ ክስተት ሀገሪቱን የሚያስተዳድረው ወታደራዊ ቡድን ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት የደቀነ ነበር። የመንግስት የቴሌቪዥን ጣቢያ እንደዘገበው ከሆነ፣ ባለስልጣናት አመጹን ተቆጣጥረው ወታደሮቹን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል።
oromo: Mootummaa Nijeer irratti fonqolcha mootummaa yaalame hordofee, waraanni hedduun magaalaa guddoo Niyaameetti to'annoo jala oolaniiru. Gochi kun bulchiinsa waraanaa biyyattii irratti balaa guddaa kan uume yoo ta'u, erga jeequmsi kun uumamee booda mootummaan to'annoo isaa jabeessera. Televizhiiniin mootummaa akka gabaasetti, qabsoon kun kan fashalaa'e yoo ta'u, shakkamtoonni kunneenis seeratti dhiyaachaa jiru.

title: Manhunt after shooting at Swiss rave kills woman, 22, and injures five
english: Swiss authorities have launched an intensive manhunt following a shooting at a techno festival in Aarau that left one 22-year-old woman dead and five others injured. The incident occurred early Sunday morning at a horse racing track where thousands had gathered for the event. Police are currently investigating the motive behind the attack and have requested public assistance as they patrol the surrounding region to locate the suspect.
amharic: በስዊዘርላንድ አራው ከተማ በተካሄደ የሙዚቃ ፌስቲቫል ላይ በተፈጸመ ተኩስ የአንዲት የ22 ዓመት ወጣት ህይወት ሲያልፍ አምስት ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ፖሊስ ጥቃቱን የፈጸመውን አካል ለመያዝ ሰፊ የሆነ ፍለጋ እየካሄደ ሲሆን፣ የተኩሱ መነሻ ምክንያት እስካሁን አልታወቀም። ባለሥልጣናት የክስተቱን እውነታ ለማጣራት ከህዝቡ ምስክርነት እና መረጃዎችን እየሰበሰቡ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Siwiizerlaand magaalaa Aarau keessatti qophii muuziqaa irratti dhukaasa banameen dargaggeetti umriin ishee 22 ta'e lubbuun yoo dabartu, namoonni shan ammoo miidhamaniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa qorannoo kana gaggeessuuf uummata irraa odeeffannoo fi ragaa barbaadaa jiru.

title: Tearful Roger Federer inducted into Tennis Hall of Fame
english: Tennis legend Roger Federer was recently inducted into the International Tennis Hall of Fame in Rhode Island. During an emotional ceremony, the 20-time Grand Slam champion expressed deep gratitude for his career and the sport that shaped his life. While he officially retired from professional competition in 2022, Federer emphasized that tennis remains central to his family, friendships, and future endeavors.
amharic: የቴኒስ ኮከብ ሮጀር ፌደረር በሮድ አይላንድ በሚገኘው ዓለም አቀፍ የቴኒስ ዝና አዳራሽ (Hall of Fame) ውስጥ ተካቷል። በስሜታዊነት በተሞላበት የክብር ሥነ-ሥርዓት ላይ፣ የ20 ጊዜ የግራንድ ስላም አሸናፊው ለስፖርቱ እና ለሙያ ሕይወቱ ያለውን ጥልቅ አድናቆት ገልጿል። ምንም እንኳን በ2022 ከውድድር ጡረታ ቢወጣም፣ ቴኒስ አሁንም ከቤተሰቡ፣ ከወዳጅነቱ እና ከወደፊት ህይወቱ ጋር የተሳሰረ እንደሆነ ተናግሯል።
oromo: Leenji'aan teniisi beekamaan Roojar Federer galma kabaja teniisi (International Tennis Hall of Fame) biyya Rhode Island keessatti galuun kabajameera. Sirna miira namaa tuqu kana irratti, injifataan rikoordii 'Grand Slam' 20 ta'e kun, jireenya isaa guutuu keessatti waan teniisi isaaf godheef galata guddaa galeera. Bara 2022 keessa tapha ogummaa isaa kan dhaabe ta'us, teniisi jireenya maatii isaa, michoota isaa fi fuuldura isaa keessatti iddoo guddaa qabaachuu isaa ibseera.

title: Chelsea sign Argentinian goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez from Aston Villa
english: Chelsea has officially signed Argentinian goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez from Aston Villa on a three-year contract. The 33-year-old World Cup winner joins the London club in a deal valued at approximately $10 million. Chelsea's manager, Xabi Alonso, hopes Martinez will address the team's ongoing challenges in the goalkeeper position.
